Dear Steve,

I am now a researcher at a university in Ho Chi Minh City. My team uses AI to help doctors and patients. For example, we build tools that help doctors read medical tests faster. I studied medicine before, so this job really suits me. Ho Chi Minh City is also my hometown. It is a busy and modern city with a lot of delicious street food.

In my free time, I enjoy reading books and going to coffee shops with my friends. At weekends, I usually go swimming. It helps me relax after a long week at work.

I would love to meet you when you visit Vietnam. Please tell me your travel dates. How about meeting on the first Saturday of your trip at 9 a.m.? We can have breakfast at Ben Thanh Market and then visit the War Remnants Museum. If this time does not suit you, just let me know.

2.answer:
Nowadays, almost every employee has a smartphone, and many people bring it to work every day. Some companies allow their staff to use phones during working hours, while others ban them. In my opinion, using personal phones at work has both advantages and disadvantages, and this essay will discuss both sides.

On the one hand, mobile phones bring several benefits at work. Firstly, employees can contact colleagues and customers quickly. For example, a salesperson can answer a customer's question by message at any time. Secondly, smartphones have many useful apps, such as calendars, maps and translation tools. These apps help workers save time and work more effectively. In addition, staff can stay in touch with their families. As a result, they feel less worried, especially when their children are sick at home.

On the other hand, using personal phones at work also causes some problems. Firstly, phones can distract employees from their tasks. Many people check social media or play games, so they waste a lot of time. Secondly, using a phone in some jobs can be dangerous. For instance, a driver or a factory worker may have an accident if they look at their phone. Moreover, personal phones can put company information at risk. Some workers send important files through apps that are not safe.

In conclusion, personal mobile phones can help employees communicate and work faster, but they can also reduce productivity and cause safety problems. I believe companies should not ban phones completely. Instead, they should make clear rules about when and how their staff can use them.

2.answer:
I think my brother should take the effective communication skills course. Let me explain why.

First, communication is useful in every job and in every situation. My brother works in an office, so he talks to his boss, his colleagues and his customers every day. If he communicates clearly, he will avoid misunderstandings and build good relationships. Second, good communication is the foundation of other skills. For example, a good presenter and a good manager must be good communicators first. So this course will help him in many ways.

I don't choose the management skills course because my brother is still a junior employee. He does not manage a team now, so this course is not very useful for him at the moment. He can take it in a few years. I also don't choose the presentation skills course. It is helpful, but he only gives presentations a few times a year. In contrast, he needs communication skills every day.

In conclusion, the effective communication skills course is the best choice for my brother because it is practical and it can help him in his whole career.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the uses of social media. In my opinion, social media has four main uses.

First, social media is a good source of entertainment. After work, many people watch funny videos or listen to music on TikTok or YouTube. It helps them relax and reduce stress.

Second, social media is very useful for doing business. Many small shops sell clothes and food on Facebook. They can reach a lot of customers without renting a shop, so they save money. For example, my aunt sells coffee from Dak Lak online, and she has customers all over Vietnam.

Third, people use social media to keep in touch with others. I often use Zalo and Facebook to chat with my friends and family. My cousin lives in Australia, but we can still call each other every week for free.

Finally, I think social media is also a great place for learning and getting information. I follow many pages about health and technology, and I read the news there every morning. In addition, students can join online groups to share study materials.

In conclusion, social media helps us relax, earn money, stay connected and learn new things. However, we should use it wisely and not spend too much time on it.
follow_ups: Yes, I think many people spend too much time on social media. Some people check their phones every few minutes, even during meals. This can hurt their health and their relationships.
The biggest disadvantage is fake news. Many people believe wrong information about health. In addition, social media can make people feel lonely and stressed.
I think social media is more useful for young people. They use it to study, find jobs and make friends. However, older people can also use it to keep in touch with their children.

2.essay_type: Causes & effects (phân tích nguyên nhân và hậu quả)

outline.content: Viết lại đề: ô nhiễm không khí nghiêm trọng, phải đeo khẩu trang → bài bàn nguyên nhân và hậu quả

2.answer:
Nowadays, air pollution is a serious problem in many big cities around the world. In some places, the air is so dirty that people have to wear masks when they go outside. This essay will discuss the main causes of air pollution and its effects on people and the environment.

There are several causes of air pollution. Firstly, the number of private vehicles is increasing quickly. For example, Ho Chi Minh City has millions of motorbikes, and they produce a lot of smoke every day. Secondly, many factories release harmful gases into the air. Some factory owners want to save money, so they do not use clean technology. In addition, people still burn rubbish and rice straw in many rural areas. As a result, thick smoke covers whole villages and nearby towns.

Air pollution has serious effects on both people and the environment. Firstly, it harms people's health. Dirty air can cause breathing problems, heart disease and even lung cancer. Children and old people suffer the most, and many of them have to go to hospital. Secondly, air pollution damages the environment. It causes acid rain, which kills trees and fish in lakes. Moreover, gases from cars and factories make the Earth warmer. This leads to climate change, with more floods and heat waves.

In conclusion, air pollution is mainly caused by traffic, factories and the burning of waste. It damages people's health and harms the natural environment. I believe governments and individuals should work together to solve this problem. For example, people should use public transport more, and factories should switch to clean energy.

2.answer:
I think the school should organize a cultural competition with prizes. Let me explain why.

First, a competition makes students active. To win, they must read about the pagoda, learn its history and understand its cultural value. For example, teams can answer quiz questions or make posters about the pagoda. In this way, students learn by doing, and they remember the information longer. Second, prizes motivate students. Many students find history boring, but they want to win a prize. Even small prizes, such as books or certificates, can make them excited. In addition, students work in teams, so they also improve their teamwork skills.

I don't choose a cultural festival because it needs a lot of money and time to prepare. Also, at a festival, students often focus on food, music and games. They have fun, but they may not learn much about the pagoda. I also don't choose a cultural event, such as a talk by a monk or a historian. It can be useful, but students only sit and listen. Many of them may feel bored and forget the information quickly.

In conclusion, a cultural competition with prizes is the best choice because it is fun, active and educational.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the effects of academic pressure on students. In my opinion, it has four main effects.

First, academic pressure leads to a lack of sleep. Many students study until midnight to finish their homework or prepare for exams. As a result, they feel tired in class the next day, and they cannot concentrate.

Second, students under pressure often get angry easily. When they are tired and worried, small problems can make them upset. For example, my cousin is in grade 12, and she often argues with her parents before exams.

Third, academic pressure reduces social interaction. Students spend most of their time studying, so they have little time for friends and family. They rarely go out or play sports. Over time, they may feel lonely.

Finally, I think academic pressure can cause mental health problems. Some students feel stressed all the time. They are afraid of failing and disappointing their parents. In serious cases, they may suffer from anxiety or depression.

In conclusion, academic pressure can harm students' sleep, mood, relationships and mental health. Parents and teachers should support students and not expect too much from them.
follow_ups: I think the main cause is high expectations from parents. Many parents want their children to enter a top university. In addition, students have to take many exams every year.
Students should make a study plan and take short breaks. They should also get enough sleep and do some exercise. If they feel very stressed, they can talk to their parents or a teacher.
Yes, I think some schools give too much homework. Many students also go to extra classes in the evening. As a result, they have no time to rest or play.

1.answer:
Dear Sarah,

Thank you for your email. It is lovely that you want to plan a party for your parents' wedding anniversary.

In my opinion, you should hold the party in a garden. A garden is more relaxed and romantic than a restaurant. Your parents love flowers, so they will enjoy it a lot. Also, you can decorate it in your own way. However, please prepare a big tent in case it rains.

I would suggest some special activities. Firstly, you can make a short video with old photos of your parents. You can show it in the garden at 7 p.m., after dinner. Secondly, family members can give short speeches about their love story. Finally, you can ask your parents to dance to their wedding song.

Yes, of course I can come one day early to help you. I will arrive on Friday at 9 a.m. In the morning, we can buy flowers and balloons at the market near your house. Then we can set up the tables and lights.

I am sure the party will be wonderful. See you soon!

Best wishes,
Minh

2.answer:
Today, artificial intelligence (AI) is developing very fast. It is used in many areas, such as education, healthcare, business and entertainment. Some people think AI makes life easier, while others worry about its negative effects. In my opinion, AI brings more benefits than problems, but we need to use it carefully.

On the one hand, AI has many advantages. Firstly, it saves time and effort. For example, chatbots can answer customers' questions 24 hours a day, so companies need fewer staff for simple tasks. Secondly, AI is very helpful in healthcare. In my job, we use AI to help doctors read X-rays faster and find diseases earlier. As a result, patients can get treatment sooner. In addition, AI can support learning. Students can use AI apps to practise English or get help with difficult lessons at any time.

On the other hand, AI also has some disadvantages. Firstly, many people may lose their jobs. Machines can do many tasks, such as entering data or answering phones, faster and more cheaply than humans. Secondly, AI can give wrong information. If people trust it too much, they may make bad decisions. Moreover, some students use AI to do their homework. This makes them lazy, and they do not learn to think for themselves. As a result, their skills become weaker.

In conclusion, AI has both advantages and disadvantages. It saves time and helps in healthcare and education, but it can also take away jobs and give wrong answers. I believe the benefits are greater. However, governments should make clear rules, and people should learn to use AI wisely.

2.answer:
I think working in a big city in my own country is the best option for me. Let me explain why.

First, big cities like Ho Chi Minh City have many good jobs. I work in AI and healthcare, so I need to be near big hospitals and universities. In a big city, I have more chances to learn and grow. Second, the salary in a big city is usually higher. Living costs are high too, but I can still save some money. In addition, I can visit my family easily. My hometown is Dak Lak, and it only takes one hour to fly there.

I don't choose working abroad because I would be very far from my family. I would also have to deal with a new language, a new culture and high living costs. It may be exciting, but it is also very stressful. I also don't choose working in my hometown. Dak Lak is a beautiful and peaceful place, but there are very few jobs in my field. The salary is also lower than in big cities.

In conclusion, working in a big city in my own country is the best choice for me. It gives me a good career, and it keeps me close to my family.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of learning foreign languages. In my opinion, there are four main benefits.

First, a foreign language gives us better career opportunities. Many international companies want to hire staff who can speak English, Japanese or Korean. These jobs often have a higher salary. For example, my friend got a job at a Korean company because she can speak Korean well.

Second, learning a language helps us understand other cultures. When we learn a language, we also learn about the people, their food and their customs. As a result, we become more open-minded, and we respect differences.

Third, foreign languages are very useful for traveling and communication. When I travel abroad, I can ask for directions, order food and talk to local people in English. This makes my trips easier and more fun.

Finally, I think a foreign language helps us get more knowledge. Many books, research papers and online courses are in English. In my job, I read many medical articles in English every week. English really helps me with my research.

In conclusion, learning a foreign language helps us find better jobs, understand other cultures, travel easily and get more knowledge. I think everyone should learn at least one foreign language.
follow_ups: English is the most popular foreign language in Vietnam. It is an international language, and students learn it at school from a young age. Many companies also require English skills.
I think the best way is to practise every day. Learners should watch films, listen to music and talk with native speakers. They should not be afraid of making mistakes.
I think children should start at about six years old. At this age, they can learn new sounds very quickly. However, parents should make learning fun and not put too much pressure on them.

2.answer:
Thanks to the Internet and social media, it is now very easy to make friends online. Many people have hundreds of online friends, but they have never met most of them in person. This essay will discuss the advantages and disadvantages of having a lot of online friends.

On the one hand, having many online friends brings several benefits. Firstly, people can learn about different cultures. For example, a Vietnamese student can chat with friends from Japan or the USA and learn about their customs. Secondly, online friends can help people practise foreign languages. Many learners improve their English by talking to friends from other countries every day. In addition, online friends can give support. People with the same problems, such as an illness, can share their feelings in online groups and feel less lonely.

On the other hand, having a lot of online friends also has some disadvantages. Firstly, online friendships are often not deep. People may have hundreds of friends online, but they have no one to help them in real life. Secondly, making friends online can be dangerous. Some people use fake profiles to cheat others or steal their money. Moreover, spending too much time with online friends can harm real relationships. Some young people chat on their phones all day and rarely talk to their own families.

In conclusion, having many online friends can help people learn about the world and get support, but it can also lead to weak and risky relationships. I believe online friends are useful, but we should be careful. We should also spend time with our friends and family in real life.

2.answer:
I think the university should build a swimming pool. Let me explain why.

First, swimming is an important life skill. Many students in Vietnam cannot swim, and every year some young people drown in rivers and lakes. With a pool on campus, students can take cheap swimming lessons and learn to stay safe. Second, swimming is good for everyone. It is great exercise for the heart and the whole body, and it rarely causes injuries. In addition, Ho Chi Minh City is hot all year round. After class, students can cool down and relax in the pool. I swim every weekend, so I know how refreshing it is.

I don't choose a gym because there are already many cheap gyms near the university. Also, only some students like lifting weights. I also don't choose a football field. It needs a lot of land, and only about twenty people can play at one time. Most of them are boys who already love football, so many other students will not use it.

In conclusion, a swimming pool is the best choice because it is suitable for everyone. It teaches a useful skill and keeps students healthy.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the importance of work-life balance. I will talk about why it is important, the problems of poor balance, some ways to achieve balance and the benefits for companies.

First, work-life balance is important because it keeps us healthy and happy. When we have time to rest, exercise and see our families, we feel less stressed. Then we can work better.

Second, poor balance causes many problems. People who work too much often feel tired and stressed. They may get headaches, sleep badly or even get sick. In addition, they have little time for their families, so their relationships can suffer.

Third, there are some simple ways to achieve balance. We should plan our time carefully and finish important tasks first. We should also stop checking work emails at night and at weekends. For example, I go swimming every Saturday, and I never work on Sundays.

Finally, I think work-life balance also brings benefits for companies. Happy employees work harder and make fewer mistakes. They are also less likely to leave the company, so the company saves money on hiring new staff.

In conclusion, work-life balance is good for both workers and companies. We should work hard, but we should also make time for ourselves and the people we love.

2.essay_type: Causes & effects (phân tích nguyên nhân và hậu quả)

outline.content: Viết lại đề: nhảy việc phổ biến ở người trẻ → bài bàn nguyên nhân và ảnh hưởng tới cá nhân, công ty

2.answer:
Nowadays, job hopping, which means changing jobs often, is very common, especially among young workers. Many people stay with one company for only one or two years and then move to another one. This essay will discuss the main causes of job hopping and its effects on individuals and companies.

There are several reasons why people change jobs frequently. Firstly, many workers want a higher salary. Often, the easiest way to get a big pay rise is to move to a new company. Secondly, young people want to learn new skills and find the right career. They try different jobs to discover what they really enjoy. In addition, some employees leave because of a bad working environment. For example, they may have a strict boss or no chance of promotion.

Job hopping has effects on both individuals and companies. For individuals, it has some good points. They can earn more money, gain different experiences and build a large network. However, frequent job changes can also look bad on a CV. Some employers think job hoppers are not loyal, so they may not hire them. For companies, job hopping is mostly negative. They lose time and money when they find and train new staff. Moreover, when experienced workers leave, the quality of work may go down.

In conclusion, people change jobs often because they want better pay, new skills and a good working environment. Job hopping can help individuals grow, but it can harm their reputation and cost companies a lot. I believe companies should offer fair pay and clear career paths to keep their staff.

I think my friend should take her daughter to a children's museum. Let me explain why.

First, a children's museum is fun and educational at the same time. Children can touch things, play games and do simple science experiments. For example, they can learn how the human body works or how plants grow. In this way, the little girl can learn new things while she plays. Second, a museum is indoors, so it is comfortable and safe. Ho Chi Minh City is very hot, and it often rains in the afternoon. In a museum, they do not need to worry about the weather. In addition, museums usually have staff who look after children carefully.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of keeping pets. In my opinion, pets bring us four main benefits.

First, pets give us companionship. People who live alone, such as old people or students, often feel lonely. A dog or a cat can be a good friend for them. For example, my grandmother lives alone, and her cat keeps her company all day.

Second, pets give us emotional support. When I come home after a stressful day, my dog, Lucky, runs to me and wags his tail. This makes me feel happy and relaxed. Some studies show that playing with pets can reduce stress and sadness.

Third, keeping pets has health benefits. Dog owners have to walk their dogs every day, so they get more exercise. As a result, their hearts are healthier, and they can keep a healthy weight. In some hospitals, animals even visit patients to help them feel better.

Finally, I think pets can teach children responsibility. When children feed and clean their pets, they learn to take care of others. They also learn to be kind and patient.

In conclusion, pets give us companionship, emotional support, better health and important life lessons. However, before we get a pet, we should make sure we have enough time to look after it.
follow_ups: In Ho Chi Minh City, most people keep dogs and cats. Dogs can protect the house, and cats can catch mice. Some people who live in small flats keep fish or birds because they need less space.
Pets can cost a lot of money for food and vet bills. They also need a lot of time and care. In addition, some pets make noise or make the house dirty.
Yes, I think children should have pets. Pets teach them to be responsible and kind. However, parents should help them and choose a safe and gentle pet.

2.answer:
Every year, millions of tonnes of plastic waste end up in rivers, seas and landfills. Plastic bags and bottles can take hundreds of years to break down. This essay will discuss the effects of dumping plastic waste into the environment and suggest some solutions.

Plastic waste has many serious effects. Firstly, it kills a lot of wild animals. For example, sea turtles often eat plastic bags because they look like jellyfish, and then they die. Secondly, plastic pollutes our land and water. When plastic breaks into tiny pieces, these pieces enter the soil, rivers and seas. As a result, they get into our fish and drinking water, and this can harm our health. In addition, plastic waste makes cities and beaches dirty. It can block drains and cause floods in the rainy season, as we often see in Ho Chi Minh City.

However, there are several ways to solve this problem. Firstly, governments should make strict laws. For instance, they can ban single-use plastic bags or make shops charge money for them. Secondly, people should change their daily habits. They can bring cloth bags when they go shopping and use their own bottles instead of buying bottled water. Moreover, companies should recycle more plastic and use packaging made from paper or leaves. Some supermarkets in Vietnam already wrap vegetables in banana leaves.

In conclusion, plastic waste harms animals, pollutes land and water and makes our cities dirty. To solve this problem, governments, individuals and companies must work together. If everyone makes small changes, our environment will become cleaner and safer. We should act now before it is too late.

Today I would like to talk about the factors that affect people's choice of jobs. In my opinion, there are four main factors.

First, salary is very important. Everyone needs money to pay for food, rent and other bills. A high salary also helps people save money and support their families. That is why many young people choose jobs in banks or IT companies.

Second, people care about the working environment. A safe, clean and modern office makes workers feel comfortable. In addition, people like flexible working hours. If the workplace is stressful or dangerous, many people will not choose that job.

Third, colleagues and bosses also affect people's choices. Friendly colleagues make work more enjoyable, and they help each other when there is a problem. A good boss gives clear instructions and praises staff for good work. For example, I chose my current job partly because my team leader is kind and supportive.

Finally, I think personal interests are also an important factor. When people love their jobs, they work harder and feel happier. I studied medicine and I love technology, so I chose a job that uses AI to help doctors.

In conclusion, salary, working environment, colleagues and bosses, and personal interests all affect people's choice of jobs. I think a good job should have a balance of all these factors.

2.answer:
Nowadays, billions of people use social media platforms such as Facebook, Instagram and TikTok every day. These platforms have changed the way we communicate, learn and have fun. However, they also cause some problems. This essay will discuss the advantages and disadvantages of social media.

On the one hand, social media has many advantages. Firstly, it helps people stay in touch with friends and family. For example, I can video call my cousin in Australia on Facebook for free. Secondly, social media is a useful place to learn and get news. Many doctors and teachers share useful videos about health and studying, and people can watch them at any time. In addition, social media helps small businesses. Many shop owners sell clothes and food online, so they can reach more customers without renting a shop.

On the other hand, social media also has some serious disadvantages. Firstly, it can be addictive. Many young people spend hours scrolling on their phones, so they have less time for studying and sleeping. Secondly, there is a lot of fake news on social media. Some people believe wrong information about health, and this can be dangerous. Moreover, social media can cause mental health problems. People often compare their lives with the perfect photos of others, and they feel sad or stressed.

In conclusion, social media helps people communicate, learn and do business, but it can also waste time, spread fake news and harm mental health. In my opinion, social media is a useful tool if we use it wisely. We should limit our screen time and always check information carefully.

2.answer:
I think my friend should work at a small school in her hometown. Let me explain why.

First, a small school is a good place for a new teacher to start. The classes are usually small, so she can get to know every student well. She will also have less pressure, and the older teachers can guide her. As a result, she can build her confidence and improve her teaching skills step by step. Second, she can live with her family in her hometown. She doesn't need to pay rent, so she can save money. In addition, she can help children in her hometown get a good education. I think this is very meaningful.

I don't choose a big school in a big city because the classes are often very large, with about forty-five students. The workload is heavy, and living costs in the city are high. I also don't choose an international school in a big city. The salary is high, but these schools usually want teachers with excellent English and many years of experience. As a new graduate, she may find it hard to get a job there.

In conclusion, a small school in her hometown is the best choice for her. She can learn with less pressure, save money and help her community.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the reasons why misbehavior among young people is increasing. In my opinion, there are four main reasons.

First, family background plays an important role. Many parents are very busy with work, so they do not spend enough time with their children. Some children grow up in families with a lot of arguments or violence. As a result, they may copy this bad behavior.

Second, school discipline is sometimes not strict enough. In some schools, the rules are not clear, and bad behavior is not punished. So students think they can do anything they want. In addition, large classes make it hard for teachers to watch every student.

Third, the Internet has strong effects on young people. Many teenagers watch violent videos or play violent games online. Some of them copy what they see. Moreover, they can easily meet bad people on social media.

Finally, I think peer pressure is another reason. Teenagers want to be accepted by their friends. If their friends smoke, skip school or fight, they may do the same things to fit in.

In conclusion, family background, weak school discipline, the Internet and peer pressure all lead to more misbehavior. Parents, schools and society should work together to guide young people.
follow_ups: Parents should spend more time talking with their children. They should also set clear rules at home and be good examples. In addition, they should know who their children's friends are.
Yes, but the punishment should be fair and not violent. For example, students can clean the classroom or write a letter of apology. The main aim is to help them learn from their mistakes.

The government should make strict laws against harmful content. It should also ask social media companies to remove violent videos quickly. In addition, it can teach young people how to use the Internet safely.

2.answer:
In many countries, the way people choose a husband or wife is changing. Some people think that young people should choose their own partners based on love. Others believe that arranged marriages, in which parents help to choose a partner, are more successful. In my opinion, love marriage is better, but young people should still listen to their parents' advice.

On the one hand, many people support love marriage. Firstly, a marriage needs love and understanding. When two people choose each other, they usually know each other's personalities and habits well before the wedding. Secondly, people have the right to decide their own lives. Marriage is a lifelong decision, so the couple should make it themselves. In addition, couples in love marriages often feel happier. They see each other as friends and partners, so they can share their problems easily.

On the other hand, some people believe arranged marriages are more likely to succeed. Firstly, parents have more life experience. They can judge whether a person is honest, responsible and hard-working. Secondly, families often choose a partner with a similar background, such as the same culture, religion or income level. As a result, the couple may have fewer conflicts. Moreover, in an arranged marriage, both families usually support the couple. For example, they help with money or look after the grandchildren.

In conclusion, both love marriage and arranged marriage have their own strengths. However, I believe love is the most important foundation for a happy marriage. Young people should choose their own partners, but they should also listen to their parents' advice before they make the final decision.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about some solutions to reduce obesity. In my opinion, there are four main solutions.

First, people should eat less fast food. Fast food, such as fried chicken, burgers and sugary drinks, has a lot of fat, sugar and salt. If people eat it often, they will gain weight quickly. We can eat fresh fruit or nuts as healthy snacks instead.

Second, cooking meals at home is a good idea. When we cook at home, we can choose fresh ingredients and use less oil and sugar. Home-cooked meals are also cheaper than restaurant meals. For example, my family usually cooks rice, fish and vegetables for dinner.

Third, people should do more exercise. Adults should exercise for at least thirty minutes a day. They can walk, ride a bike or swim. I go swimming every weekend, and it helps me stay fit and relaxed.

Finally, I think getting enough sleep is also important. Research shows that people who sleep less than six hours a night often feel hungrier. They tend to eat more snacks late at night. So adults should sleep about seven to eight hours every night.

In conclusion, eating less fast food, cooking at home, doing more exercise and getting enough sleep can help reduce obesity. Small changes in our daily habits can make a big difference to our health.

1.answer:
Dear Lucy,

Thank you for your email. I am so happy that you are planning to visit Ho Chi Minh City!

In my opinion, the best time to visit is from December to April. This is the dry season, so it rarely rains. The weather is sunny but not too hot. If you come in late January or February, you can also enjoy Tet, our Lunar New Year.

There are many interesting things to see and do here. You can visit Ben Thanh Market, the War Remnants Museum and the Independence Palace. In the evening, you should walk along Nguyen Hue Walking Street and try street food, such as banh mi and broken rice. You can also take a day trip to the Cu Chi Tunnels.

The easiest way to get here is by plane. You can fly to Tan Son Nhat Airport and then take a Grab car to the city centre. I suggest you stay at a hotel in District 1 because many famous places are within walking distance.

Let me know your plans, and I will show you around at the weekend.

Best wishes,
Minh

2.answer:
In recent years, tourism has grown quickly in many parts of the world. More and more visitors travel to famous places, and many new hotels, restaurants and attractions are built for them. This essay will discuss the positive and negative effects of tourism development on local people and on the environment and landscape.

On the one hand, tourism brings many benefits to local residents. Firstly, it creates a lot of jobs. For example, local people can work in hotels and restaurants or become tour guides. Secondly, tourism increases people's income and improves their living standards. Many families in Hoi An earn good money by selling souvenirs or running homestays. In addition, the government often builds better roads, hospitals and schools in tourist areas. As a result, local people can use better services.

On the other hand, tourism development can harm the environment and the landscape. Firstly, large numbers of tourists create a lot of rubbish and pollution. Beaches and rivers become dirty, and wild animals lose their homes. Secondly, many hotels and resorts are built in beautiful natural areas. Forests are cut down, and tall buildings ruin the natural view. For instance, some parts of the coast in Nha Trang are now full of high-rise hotels. Moreover, local people may suffer from higher prices and crowded streets.

In conclusion, tourism development helps local people by creating jobs, increasing income and improving services. However, it can also pollute the environment and damage the landscape. In my opinion, tourism should be developed carefully. Governments should protect natural areas and control the number of new buildings.

2.answer:
I think using a mobile phone while driving should be punished most strictly. Let me explain why.

First, it is very dangerous. When drivers look at their phones, they do not see the road for a few seconds. In that short time, they can hit another car or a person. Many serious accidents in Vietnam happen because drivers text or make calls. Second, it can harm innocent people. A driver who uses a phone puts other people on the road in danger too. For example, a child on a bicycle can be badly hurt or even killed. In addition, strict fines will make drivers think twice before they pick up their phones.

I don't choose talking loudly in public places because it is only annoying. It is impolite, but it does not hurt anyone's health or life. A small fine or a polite reminder is enough. I also don't choose smoking in restaurants. It is bad for other people's health, so it should be fined too. However, it is less dangerous than using a phone while driving, which can kill people in a second.

In conclusion, using a mobile phone while driving should get the strictest punishment because it can cause deadly accidents.

outline.reusable: Second, it helps us understand body language and emotions.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the importance of face-to-face communication. In my opinion, it is important for four main reasons.

First, face-to-face communication helps us build trust and relationships. When we meet someone in person, we can shake hands, smile and look into their eyes. This makes people feel closer to each other. For example, I always feel closer to my friends after we have coffee together.

Second, it helps us understand body language and emotions. When we talk in person, we can see the other person's face and hear their voice. So we know if they are happy, sad or angry. In my work, doctors often say that meeting patients in person helps them understand their feelings better.

Third, face-to-face communication helps us avoid misunderstandings. Text messages can be short and unclear, and people may read them in the wrong way. When we talk directly, we can ask questions and explain our ideas immediately.

Finally, I think face-to-face communication leads to better teamwork. When team members meet in person, they can share ideas quickly and solve problems together. My team has a meeting every Monday morning, and it helps us work much better.

In conclusion, face-to-face communication helps us build trust, understand emotions, avoid misunderstandings and work better as a team. Even in the digital age, we should still meet people in person.
follow_ups: Yes, I think so. Nowadays, people often send messages or make video calls instead of meeting. Smartphones make online communication fast and easy.
Online messages are often short and unclear, so they can cause misunderstandings. Also, we cannot see body language. In addition, people may feel lonely if they only talk online.

Face-to-face communication is better for important conversations, such as job interviews or sharing bad news. It is also better when we visit a doctor. In these situations, we need to see people's faces and feelings.

Hi Chris,

Thank you for your email. I am so happy you are coming to Vietnam! Of course I don't mind. You can come next week. I can't wait to see you too.

Firstly, you should visit Ho Chi Minh City, Hoi An and Ha Long Bay. In Ho Chi Minh City, you can try street food and visit Ben Thanh Market. In Hoi An, you can walk around the old town at night and take a boat trip. In Ha Long Bay, you can go kayaking and see beautiful islands.

Secondly, August is very hot in Vietnam, and it often rains. You should bring light clothes, such as T-shirts and shorts. Don't forget a raincoat, sunglasses, sunscreen and a hat. You should also bring comfortable shoes because you will walk a lot.

2.essay_type: Advantages & disadvantages (thảo luận lợi ích và nguy cơ của thanh toán không tiền mặt)

outline.content: Viết lại đề: Internet, điện thoại phổ biến → nhiều người trả tiền bằng app, ví điện tử, mã QR → bài bàn cả lợi ích và nguy cơ
outline.reusable: This trend brings many benefits, but it also has some potential dangers. This essay will discuss both sides.

outline.content: (1) nhanh, tiện (quét QR vài giây) (2) không phải mang nhiều tiền mặt → ít bị mất, bị cướp (3) quản lý chi tiêu tốt hơn nhờ app ghi lại
outline.reusable: On the one hand, cashless payment has several benefits. Firstly, it is fast and convenient.

outline.content: (1) lừa đảo trực tuyến, tin nhắn giả (2) người lớn tuổi khó dùng (3) phụ thuộc công nghệ: hết pin, mất mạng là không trả được
outline.reusable: On the other hand, cashless payment also has some dangers. Firstly, online fraud is a serious problem.

outline.content: Tóm tắt hai mặt + ý kiến: lợi nhiều hơn hại; người dùng bảo vệ thông tin, ngân hàng làm app an toàn hơn
outline.reusable: In my opinion, the benefits are greater than the dangers.

2.answer:
Nowadays, the Internet and smartphones are very popular around the world. As a result, many people now pay with mobile banking apps, e-wallets and QR codes instead of cash. This trend brings many benefits, but it also has some potential dangers. This essay will discuss both sides.

On the one hand, cashless payment has several benefits. Firstly, it is fast and convenient. For example, people can pay for a coffee or a taxi by scanning a QR code in a few seconds. Secondly, people do not need to carry a lot of cash, so they are less likely to lose money or be robbed in the street. In addition, cashless payment helps people manage their money better. Most banking apps record every payment, so users can see how much they spend each month.

On the other hand, cashless payment also has some dangers. Firstly, online fraud is a serious problem. Criminals can send fake messages or links to steal passwords and money from bank accounts. Secondly, some people, especially elderly people, find these apps difficult to use. As a result, they may make mistakes or feel left behind. Moreover, cashless payment depends on technology. If the phone battery dies or the Internet connection is weak, people cannot pay for anything.

In conclusion, cashless payment makes our lives faster and easier, but it can also bring risks such as fraud and technical problems. In my opinion, the benefits are greater than the dangers. However, users should protect their personal information carefully, and banks should make their apps safer and easier to use.

2.answer:
I think my friend should choose minigames for the children at her Year End Party. Let me explain why.

First, young children love games. Games are fun and active, so all the students will enjoy the party. For example, they can play musical chairs, a balloon race or a quiz game. Second, minigames help children work in teams. They can learn to share, help each other and make new friends. Third, minigames are cheap and easy to organise. My friend only needs some balloons, small gifts and a big room.

I don't choose a cooking workshop because it can be dangerous for young children. They may cut their fingers or touch hot pans. It also needs a lot of food and equipment, so it is expensive. I also don't choose a music and fashion show. Only some confident students can sing or walk on the stage. Shy children will just sit and watch, so they may feel bored. Also, the teacher needs a lot of time to prepare costumes and practise with the children.

In conclusion, minigames for the children are the best choice for the Year End Party because they are fun, safe and cheap, and every child can join in.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the reasons why young people lose their jobs. In my opinion, there are four main reasons.

First, some young people have a bad attitude at work. They come to work late, complain a lot or do not respect their colleagues. Managers do not want to keep staff like this, even if they are smart.

Second, many young people lack the skills that companies need. At university, they learn a lot of theory, but they have little practical experience. For example, some graduates cannot write a clear email or use basic office software. In addition, many of them have weak soft skills, such as teamwork and communication.

Third, some young people have unrealistic salary expectations. They want a high salary from the first day, but they do not have enough experience. When the company cannot pay them more, they lose motivation and work badly. As a result, they may lose their jobs.

Finally, I think poor time management is another reason. Some young employees spend too much time on their phones and miss deadlines. If this happens many times, the manager will lose trust in them.

In conclusion, young people lose their jobs because of a bad attitude, a lack of skills, unrealistic salary expectations and poor time management. They should work hard, keep learning and be patient.
follow_ups: They should have a positive attitude and always be on time. They should also keep learning new skills, for example by taking short online courses. Most importantly, they should be patient and not expect too much too soon.
No, I don't think so. Many schools focus too much on theory and exams. Students need more practical training, such as internships and group projects.

Employers can give young employees clear goals and regular feedback. They can also give each new employee a mentor, who is an experienced colleague. In addition, short training courses can help them improve quickly.

1.answer:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for your email. I am sorry to hear about your weight, but don't worry. Many students have the same problem, and I am happy to help.

Firstly, you should start exercising right now. You don't need to do too much at the beginning. For example, you can walk for thirty minutes every evening or go swimming twice a week. You should also take the stairs instead of the lift.

Secondly, there are some habits you should avoid. Try not to eat out every day because restaurant food often has a lot of oil, salt and sugar. You should also stop drinking soft drinks and eating late at night. Moreover, don't sit in front of your computer for too long.

Finally, I recommend a simple and cheap diet. For breakfast, you can have eggs, bread and a banana. For lunch and dinner, eat brown rice, vegetables, fish or chicken. If you feel hungry, have some fruit instead of snacks. You can cook at home on Sunday afternoon and take your lunch to university.

Good luck! I'm sure you will get back in shape soon.

Best wishes,
Minh

2.answer:
Nowadays, more and more people work or study in public places, such as coffee shops and parks, instead of in an office or at home. Some people think this is a pleasant and productive way to work, while others believe it causes problems. This essay will discuss both the advantages and disadvantages of this trend.

On the one hand, working in public places has several advantages. Firstly, a new environment can make people feel more creative. For example, a writer may get new ideas when he sits in a park and looks at the trees. Secondly, people feel less lonely in a coffee shop than at home. They can see other people and sometimes meet friends after work. In addition, many coffee shops have free Wi-Fi, comfortable chairs and good drinks. As a result, people can work there for many hours.

On the other hand, working in public places also has some disadvantages. Firstly, these places are often noisy. Loud music and people's conversations can make it hard to focus on difficult tasks. Secondly, public Wi-Fi is not always safe. Hackers may steal personal information or company documents. Moreover, working in coffee shops can be expensive. If a person buys two drinks every day, he will spend a lot of money each month.

In conclusion, working in public places can make people more creative and less lonely, but it also has problems with noise, safety and cost. In my opinion, it is a good choice for simple tasks or short periods. However, for important work, an office or a quiet room at home is still better.

2.answer:
I think I should choose to work for a foreign company. Let me explain why.

First, a foreign company usually offers a good salary and many benefits, such as health insurance and paid holidays. This helps me feel safe about money. Second, I can improve my English every day. I will use English in meetings and emails with colleagues from other countries. Third, foreign companies often have a clear training programme and a professional working environment. As a result, I can learn a lot and build a strong career.

I don't choose a family-owned company because the important jobs often go to family members. It may be hard for me to get a promotion there. In addition, the owners sometimes make decisions in a traditional way, so new ideas may not be welcome. I also don't choose a start-up company. Start-ups are exciting, but they are risky. Many of them close after one or two years, and the working hours are often very long. As a new graduate, I want a stable job first.

In conclusion, a foreign company is the best choice for me because it offers a good salary, a chance to use English and a clear career path.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the advantages of electric vehicles. In my opinion, they have four main advantages.

First, electric vehicles help to protect the environment. They do not produce exhaust fumes, so the air in big cities becomes cleaner. This is very important in Ho Chi Minh City, where air pollution is a serious problem.

Second, electric vehicles have lower running costs. Charging a battery is much cheaper than buying petrol. For example, my friend has an electric car, and he saves about two million dong a month on fuel. In addition, electric vehicles need less maintenance because they have fewer parts.

Third, drivers can gain a better driving experience. Electric cars start quickly and run very smoothly. Many of them also have modern technology, such as large screens and smart safety systems.

Finally, I think electric vehicles help to reduce noise pollution. Their engines are very quiet, so the streets become more peaceful. People who live near busy roads can sleep and work better.

In conclusion, electric vehicles protect the environment, save money, give a better driving experience and reduce noise. I believe more people will use them in the future.
follow_ups: Yes, I think they are better in many ways. They are cleaner, quieter and cheaper to run. However, gasoline vehicles are still better for long trips because it is easier to find a petrol station.
First, electric vehicles are usually more expensive to buy. Second, there are not many charging stations in some areas. Charging a battery also takes much longer than filling a tank with petrol.

Governments can reduce taxes on electric vehicles, so they will be cheaper. They can also build more charging stations in cities and on highways. In addition, they can offer free parking for electric cars.

1.answer:
Dear Mr. Harris,

Thank you for your email. I am very pleased that your company is interested in my hometown, Da Nang.

Firstly, Da Nang has many famous tourist attractions. My Khe Beach is one of the most beautiful beaches in Vietnam. Visitors can also take a cable car to Ba Na Hills and walk on the Golden Bridge. In addition, the Marble Mountains and the Dragon Bridge are very popular.

Secondly, the best time to visit is from February to May, when the weather is sunny and dry. There are many types of accommodation, such as luxury resorts, hotels and cheap homestays. For transport, tourists can take a taxi, book a Grab car or rent a motorbike. The airport is only ten minutes from the city centre.

Thirdly, I believe foreign tourists would enjoy visiting Da Nang for several reasons. The city is clean, safe and not too crowded. The seafood is fresh and cheap. Moreover, the ancient town of Hoi An is only 30 kilometres away.

I hope this information is useful. Please contact me if you need any more details.

Yours sincerely,
Nguyen Van Minh

outline.content: Viết lại đề: Internet phát triển nhanh ở Việt Nam → tội phạm mạng tăng → bài bàn tác động và giải pháp

outline.content: Tóm tắt tác động + mọi bên cùng hành động

2.answer:
In recent years, Vietnam has seen rapid growth in Internet use. Millions of people now shop, bank and share information online every day. However, this has also led to a rise in cybercrime. This essay will discuss the impact of cybercrime on individuals and society and suggest some solutions.

Cybercrime has a serious impact on both individuals and society. Firstly, many victims lose money. For example, an elderly person may click on a fake bank link and lose his life savings in a few minutes. Secondly, victims often suffer from stress and fear. Some of them stop using online services because they no longer trust them. In addition, cybercrime harms businesses. When a company's system is attacked, customers' data can be leaked, and the company loses its good reputation. As a result, people become less confident about the digital economy.

However, there are several solutions to this problem. Firstly, the government should make stricter laws and punish cybercriminals more heavily. It should also work with banks to block fake websites quickly. Secondly, companies must protect their systems better. For instance, they can use two-factor authentication and update their security software regularly. Moreover, individuals need to learn how to stay safe online. Schools and the media can teach people, especially the elderly, not to share passwords or click on strange links.

In conclusion, cybercrime causes financial loss, stress and damage to the reputation of businesses. To solve this problem, governments, companies and individuals must work together. If everyone takes action, the Internet will become a safer place for all of us.

I think going backpacking with friends is the best way to spend my two-week summer holiday. Let me explain why.

First, backpacking is cheap. We can stay in hostels or homestays and eat local food, so we don't need to spend much money. Second, backpacking gives us a lot of freedom. We can decide where to go and how long to stay. For example, if we love a small village in Ha Giang, we can stay there one more day. Third, going with friends is fun and safe. We can share costs, help each other and create beautiful memories together.

I don't choose a package tour because it has a fixed schedule. We have to get up early and follow the group all the time, so we cannot really relax. A package tour is also more expensive. I also don't choose staying at home. Two weeks is a long time, and I already spend most of the year at home and at work. If I stay at home, I will just use my phone and feel bored.

In conclusion, going backpacking with friends is the best choice because it is cheap, flexible and exciting.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about using mobile phones at school. I think there are four main points.

First, mobile phones have many benefits for learning. Students can look up new words, watch educational videos and use learning apps. For example, my nephew uses an app to practise English every day after class.

Second, phones can cause distractions in class. Some students play games or check social media when the teacher is speaking. As a result, they do not understand the lesson and get lower marks.

Third, phones are important for safety and communication. Parents can call their children if there is a problem. Students can also contact their parents when they finish school late or feel sick.

Finally, I think we should also think about the effects on students' health. If students look at their screens for too long, they may have eye problems and headaches. Some students also use their phones late at night, so they do not get enough sleep.

In conclusion, mobile phones can help students learn and stay safe, but they can also cause distractions and health problems. Schools should make clear rules so that students use their phones responsibly.
follow_ups: I think schools should allow phones only for learning activities. For example, teachers can let students use phones to search for information. At other times, phones should stay in students' bags.

Teachers can make clear rules about when students can use their phones. They can also show students useful learning apps. In addition, teachers should be good examples and not use their own phones in class.
I think children should have their own phones at about twelve or thirteen years old. At this age, they start to go to school alone. However, parents should check which apps they use.

2.answer:
In many cities, streets, buildings and advertising signs are brightly lit all night. This causes light pollution, which harms people's health, wildlife and our view of the night sky. In my opinion, both governments and individuals can take simple steps to reduce this problem.

Governments can do several things. Firstly, they should replace old street lights with modern lights that point down to the ground. As a result, less light goes up into the sky, and people can see the stars more clearly. Secondly, governments can make laws about advertising signs. For example, they can ask shops and companies to turn off their signs after 11 p.m. In addition, governments can use smart street lights in quiet areas. These lights become brighter only when people or cars pass by, so they also save energy.

Individuals can also help to reduce light pollution. Firstly, people should turn off lights that they do not need, especially outdoor lights in gardens and on balconies. Secondly, they can close their curtains at night. This keeps the light inside their homes and also helps them sleep better. Moreover, people can choose warm, low-energy light bulbs instead of very bright white lights. Finally, they can join events such as Earth Hour to learn more about this problem and share it with their friends and family.

In conclusion, light pollution is a serious problem, but we can reduce it. Governments should improve street lights and control advertising signs, while individuals should turn off unnecessary lights and close their curtains at night. If everyone works together, we will have healthier cities and see the stars again.

2.answer:
I think we should go to a Japanese restaurant this weekend. Let me explain why.

First, Japanese food is healthy. It has a lot of fish, rice and vegetables, and it is not oily. Many of my friends are trying to eat healthily, so this is a good choice for them. Second, Japanese food is beautiful and fresh. Dishes like sushi and sashimi look like art, so we can take nice photos together. Third, Japanese restaurants are usually quiet and clean. This is perfect for a long dinner when we want to chat and catch up.

I don't choose a Thai restaurant because Thai food is often very spicy. Two of my friends cannot eat spicy food, so they may not enjoy the meal. I also don't choose a Chinese restaurant. Chinese food is tasty, but it is often oily and heavy. Also, Chinese restaurants are often busy and noisy, so it may be hard to talk.

In conclusion, a Japanese restaurant is the best option for our dinner because the food is healthy and fresh, and the place is good for talking.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the causes of obesity in children. In my opinion, there are four main causes.

First, many children have unhealthy eating habits. They eat a lot of fast food, sweets and soft drinks. These foods have too much sugar and fat, but very few vitamins.

Second, many children today do not get enough physical activity. In big cities like Ho Chi Minh City, there are not many parks or playgrounds. Many children spend all day at school and then go to extra classes, so they have no time to play sports.

Third, children have too much screen time. They watch cartoons, play video games or use social media for many hours. While they sit in front of a screen, they often eat snacks too.

Finally, I think busy parents are another cause. Many parents work long hours, so they do not have time to cook healthy meals. Instead, they buy fast food or give their children money to buy snacks.

In conclusion, unhealthy eating habits, a lack of physical activity, too much screen time and busy parents all cause obesity in children. Families and schools should work together to solve this problem.
follow_ups: I think both parents and schools should be responsible. However, parents play a bigger role because children eat most of their meals at home. Schools can help by teaching children about healthy food and sport.

Parents can cook healthy meals at home with lots of vegetables and fruit. They should not keep sweets or soft drinks in the house. They can also cook together with their children to make healthy food fun.
Yes, I think so. Children cannot always make good choices, and these advertisements make fast food look very attractive. If there are fewer advertisements, children will ask for fast food less often.

1.answer:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for your email. I'm so excited that you are finally coming to Vietnam! Here is some advice for your trip.

Firstly, I think you should visit three places. Start in Ha Noi and take a boat trip in Ha Long Bay. Then fly to Hoi An and walk around the old town at night. After that, come to Ho Chi Minh City, where I live. We can explore the city together on my motorbike.

Secondly, I recommend the War Remnants Museum in District 3 of Ho Chi Minh City. It shows the history of the Vietnam War with many photos and real objects. It is really worth visiting. It is open every day from 7:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. How about going there together on Saturday morning?

Finally, you should definitely try pho, banh mi and broken rice. Pho is a noodle soup with beef, and banh mi is a Vietnamese sandwich. They are cheap and delicious. Don't forget to try iced milk coffee too!

Let me know your travel dates, and I will help you plan more.

Best wishes,
Minh

2.answer:
With the fast development of technology, many schools are thinking about replacing printed textbooks with tablets and e-readers. Some people believe that schools should keep traditional printed books, while others think digital textbooks should replace them completely. In my opinion, schools should not replace printed textbooks completely, but they should use both types.

On the one hand, there are good reasons to keep printed textbooks. Firstly, paper books are better for students' eyes. Looking at a screen for many hours can cause eye problems and headaches. Secondly, printed books help students focus. With a tablet, students can easily open games or social media during the lesson. In addition, printed books do not need electricity or an Internet connection. This is important for poor students and schools in rural areas.

On the other hand, many people support digital textbooks for several reasons. Firstly, one tablet can store hundreds of books. As a result, students do not need to carry heavy school bags every day. Secondly, digital textbooks can include videos, pictures and games. For example, a science lesson can show a short video about the human heart, so students understand it more easily. Moreover, digital books are easy to update, while printed books can quickly become out of date.

In conclusion, both printed and digital textbooks have their own strengths. I believe printed textbooks are still necessary because they are healthier and help students focus. However, schools should also use digital textbooks for extra materials, such as videos and online exercises. This combination is the best way to help students learn.

2.answer:
I think our class should choose fried rice for the potluck party. Let me explain why.

First, fried rice is easy to cook. We only need rice, eggs, carrots, peas and some sausage. Even students who cannot cook well can help to cut vegetables or mix the rice. Second, it is cheap. The ingredients are easy to buy at any market, so each student only needs to pay a little money. Third, fried rice is easy to carry and serve. We can put it in big boxes and share it with everyone. Almost everyone likes fried rice, so nobody will go hungry.

I don't choose fried spring rolls because they take a long time to prepare. We have to roll each one by hand, and frying them in hot oil can be dangerous. I also don't choose beef noodles. To make good beef noodles, we need to cook the broth for many hours. It is also difficult to bring hot soup to the party, and we will need a lot of bowls.

In conclusion, fried rice is the best dish for our class because it is easy, cheap and convenient.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of traveling in a group. In my opinion, there are four main benefits.

First, traveling in a group helps us share costs and reduce travel expenses. We can share a hotel room, a taxi or a big meal. For example, last year I went to Da Lat with four friends, and we rented a whole house for a very good price.

Second, we feel safer and more supported during the trip. If someone gets lost or sick, the others can help. This is very important when we visit a new place where we don't speak the language.

Third, group travel creates shared memories and stronger friendships. We eat, play and solve problems together. After the trip, we often look at our photos and laugh about the funny moments.

Finally, I think group travel is also good for learning. We can learn from each other on the trip. One friend may be good at planning, and another may know a lot about history or food. As a result, the trip becomes more interesting.

In conclusion, traveling in a group saves money, makes us feel safe, builds friendships and helps us learn new things. That is why I usually travel with my friends.
follow_ups: The main advantage is that it is cheaper because we can share costs. It is also safer and more fun. We always have someone to talk to and help us.
Yes, there are some disadvantages. It can be hard to agree on where to go and what to do. Sometimes people argue because they have different habits.
I think group traveling is more suitable for young people. They usually have less money, so sharing costs is very helpful. They also enjoy making new friends and having fun together.

1.answer:
Hi Coral,

Thanks for your email. I'm glad you are coming to Ho Chi Minh City next week. I hope your meeting goes well!

Firstly, the best venue is the meeting room at the Rex Hotel in District 1. It is modern and quiet, and it has a good projector. It is also near many restaurants and shops. I suggest booking it for Tuesday from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. because it is often busy at the end of the week.

Secondly, the total cost is about 600,000 dong per person, which is around 25 US dollars. This price includes the room, tea and coffee in the morning and a buffet lunch. If more than twenty people join, the hotel will give a ten percent discount.

Finally, online payment is available. You can pay by bank transfer or by credit card when you book. However, you should bring a little cash for taxis and street food. Many small shops in Vietnam only accept cash.

Let me know if you need any more help. I can meet you at the hotel after the meeting.

Best wishes,
Minh

2.answer:
Nowadays, many children spend a lot of time on smartphones, tablets and video games instead of playing outdoors or reading books. Parents and teachers are worried that this habit can harm children's health and social skills. This essay will discuss the causes of this habit, the problems it causes and some possible solutions.

There are several causes of this problem. Firstly, many parents are very busy with work. They give their children a phone or a tablet to keep them quiet, so the children get used to screens from a young age. Secondly, games and videos are designed to be very attractive. In addition, many cities do not have enough parks or safe places to play. This habit causes serious problems. Children who sit in front of screens for hours may become overweight and have eye problems. They also spend less time talking and playing with other people, so their social skills become weaker.

However, there are some solutions to this problem. Firstly, parents should set clear rules about screen time. For instance, children can use a tablet for one hour after they finish their homework. Parents should also be good examples and put their own phones away during meals. Secondly, schools can organise more outdoor activities, sports and reading clubs. These activities help children make friends and stay healthy. Moreover, local governments should build more parks and playgrounds, so children have safe places to play.

In conclusion, children use electronic devices too much because of busy parents, attractive apps and a lack of play areas. This habit can harm their health and social skills. Parents, schools and governments must work together to solve this problem. If children spend less time on screens, they will grow up healthier and happier.

2.answer:
I think my family should hold the party at a restaurant. Let me explain why.

First, a restaurant is very convenient. The staff will cook, serve the food and clean up after the party. As a result, everyone in my family can relax and enjoy the celebration. Second, restaurants have many dishes to choose from. We can order food that both young and old people like. Third, it is easy for everyone to get there. We can choose a restaurant in the city centre, so our relatives do not need to travel far.

I don't choose to hold the party at a resort because it is too expensive and too far away. Some old people in my family cannot travel for many hours. I also don't choose to hold the party at a family member's house. The house may be too small for all our relatives. In addition, the host will be very tired because she has to cook and clean all day. On a special day, everyone should have fun, including the host.

In conclusion, holding the party at a restaurant is the best choice because it is convenient, comfortable and easy for everyone to reach.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of traveling. In my opinion, traveling has four main benefits.

First, traveling helps us experience new cultures. We can try local food, see traditional festivals and learn how people live. For example, when I visited Thailand, I learned how Thai people show respect to monks and old people.

Second, we can learn new skills when we travel. We have to plan the trip, read maps and manage our money. We can also practise a foreign language, especially English, when we talk to local people.

Third, traveling helps us gain more life experience. Sometimes we miss a bus or lose our way, and we have to solve the problem by ourselves. These situations make us more confident and independent.

Finally, I think traveling helps us relax and reduce stress. After months of hard work, a trip to the beach or the mountains gives us new energy. When we come back, we can work better.

In conclusion, traveling helps us understand new cultures, learn new skills, gain life experience and relax. That is why I try to travel at least twice a year.
follow_ups: My most memorable trip was to Da Lat with my university friends three years ago. We stayed in a small wooden house and drank hot coffee in the cool morning air. It was cheap but very fun.
I would rather go with my friends. We have similar interests, so we can do exciting activities like hiking or camping. However, I also enjoy short trips with my family during Tet.
I would choose a standard tour. It is cheaper, and I don't need a luxury hotel because I spend most of my time outside. I would rather spend my money on food and activities.

Hi Minh,

Thanks for your message! I'm so happy that you are coming to Ho Chi Minh City next month. It has been a long time since we last met.

Life in my city has been busy but exciting recently. The first metro line has opened, so travelling around the city is easier now. However, the weather has been very hot, and it often rains in the afternoon.

I'd prefer to meet in the evening. During the day, I work at the university until 5 p.m. Also, the weather is cooler in the evening, so it is more pleasant to walk around.

You should visit Nguyen Hue Walking Street because it is beautiful at night. How about meeting at a coffee shop there on Friday at 7 p.m.? After that, we can have dinner at Ben Thanh Night Market.

By the way, do you need to bring anything for me from your hometown? Please don't worry about it. But if you have space in your bag, I would love some green rice cakes from Ha Noi!

I can't wait to see you.

2.answer:
Fast fashion is growing very quickly around the world. It reportedly produces about 10% of global carbon emissions. It also causes other serious problems. For example, factories use huge amounts of water and pollute rivers with chemicals. This essay will discuss the main causes and problems of fast fashion and suggest some solutions.

There are several causes of this problem. Firstly, fast fashion clothes are very cheap. As a result, people buy many new items and throw them away after wearing them only a few times. Every year, millions of tonnes of clothes end up in landfills. Secondly, social media and advertising encourage people to follow trends. For example, young people often want a new outfit for every photo they post online. In addition, fashion companies produce huge amounts of clothes very quickly. They use cheap materials like polyester, which comes from oil and does not break down easily.

However, there are some solutions to reduce this problem. Firstly, governments should make stricter laws for fashion companies. For instance, they can tax companies that pollute and support brands that use recycled materials or organic cotton. Secondly, companies should produce clothes that last longer and offer recycling services in their shops. Moreover, consumers can change their shopping habits. They should buy fewer but better clothes, repair old items and buy second-hand clothes. People can also give unwanted clothes to charity instead of throwing them away.

In conclusion, fast fashion pollutes the air, water and land. This happens because clothes are cheap, trends change quickly and companies produce too much. Governments, companies and consumers all need to take action. If everyone buys more carefully, we can protect our planet for future generations.

I think we should have dinner at a Thai restaurant to celebrate finishing our final exams. Let me explain why.

First, my friend and I both love spicy and sour food. Thai dishes like tom yum soup and green curry are full of flavour, so they are perfect for a special night. Second, Thai food is not expensive. As students, we do not have much money, but we can still order many dishes to share. Third, Thai restaurants often have a lively and colourful atmosphere. After months of hard study, we want a fun place to relax and celebrate.

I don't choose a Japanese restaurant because it is usually quite expensive. Good sushi costs a lot of money, and the portions are often small. I also don't choose a Chinese restaurant. Chinese food is delicious, but the dishes are usually big. They are better for a large group or a family, not for two people.

In conclusion, a Thai restaurant is the best choice for our celebration dinner because the food is tasty, the prices are reasonable and the atmosphere is fun.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the factors that contribute to childhood obesity in modern society. In my opinion, there are four main factors.

First, many children have unhealthy eating habits. They often eat fast food, fried snacks and sweets, and they drink a lot of bubble tea and soft drinks. These foods contain too much sugar and fat.

Second, children today have a lack of physical activity and too much screen time. Instead of playing outside, they spend hours watching videos or playing games on tablets. As a result, they burn very few calories.

Third, the family and social environment also plays a big role. If parents eat unhealthy food, their children usually copy them. In addition, fast food restaurants and convenience stores are everywhere in big cities, so it is very easy to buy junk food.

Finally, I think a lack of sleep is another factor. Many children stay up late to do homework or use their phones. When they are tired, they feel hungry and want to eat more sugary food.

In conclusion, unhealthy eating, a lack of exercise, too much screen time, the family environment and a lack of sleep all lead to childhood obesity. Parents and schools should help children build healthy habits from an early age.
follow_ups: Parents can cook healthy meals at home and keep less junk food in the house. They should also limit screen time and encourage their children to play sports. For example, they can take their children swimming at weekends.
Yes, I think so. Children eat lunch at school almost every day, so schools can serve healthy meals. They can also teach students about nutrition and organise more sports activities.

Hi Minho,

First, it is quite cold in Ha Noi in winter, usually about 12 to 18 degrees. It is also wet and windy. You should bring a warm jacket, some sweaters, a scarf and comfortable boots. However, Korea is much colder, so you don't need very heavy clothes.

Secondly, if it is too cold to go out, there are many indoor activities we can do. We can go to Vincom Mega Mall to see a film or go bowling. We can also visit the Museum of Ethnology on Saturday morning. In the evening, we can cook hotpot at my home and play board games with my family.

Best wishes,
