2.answer:
Nowadays, it is common to see friends buying the same things, such as smartphones, jackets or accessories. Some people think this is simply a way to strengthen friendship and follow trends. However, others believe it shows a natural human tendency to copy the people around us. In my opinion, both views are partly true, but imitation is the main reason.

On the one hand, some people believe that buying the same items is a way to build friendship. Firstly, matching items make friends feel closer. For example, two best friends may buy the same bracelet to remember a special trip. Secondly, having the same items gives them a feeling of belonging to a group. In addition, many young people want to follow trends. When a new phone or a new style of shoes becomes popular, a whole group of friends may buy it together.

On the other hand, others argue that people naturally imitate those around them. Firstly, humans learn by copying. From a young age, children copy the way their parents and friends talk, dress and behave. Secondly, people trust the choices of their friends. If a friend says that his new phone is good, we often believe him and buy the same one without much research. Moreover, many people do not want to feel different from others, so they choose the same things as their friends.

In conclusion, buying the same items as friends can help people feel closer and follow trends. However, I believe it mostly comes from our natural habit of imitating others. People should think carefully about their own needs before they buy something just because their friends have it.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the trend of eating out among young people. I will talk about four main points.

First, let me talk about the popularity of eating out among young people today. In big cities like Ha Noi and Ho Chi Minh City, restaurants, coffee shops and food stalls are full of young people every evening. Many of my friends eat out almost every day.

Second, there are several reasons why young people prefer eating out. They are busy with study and work, so they do not have time to cook. Eating out is also a good way to meet friends and try new dishes. In addition, food delivery apps make it very easy to order food.

Third, young people have some criteria for choosing a good restaurant. The food must be tasty, and the price must be reasonable. The place should also be clean and have a nice atmosphere for taking photos. Many young people read online reviews before they choose a place.

Finally, I think we should talk about the problems of eating out too often. Restaurant food often has a lot of oil, salt and sugar, so it can be bad for our health. It also costs more money than cooking at home.

In conclusion, eating out is a popular trend because it is convenient and fun. However, young people should eat out wisely and cook at home sometimes.
follow_ups: Yes, I think young people eat out very often nowadays. Many of them eat out several times a week, especially at lunchtime. Some even eat out every day.
They are busy, so eating out saves time. They also enjoy meeting friends and trying new food. In addition, many young people don't know how to cook well.
People should think about the quality of the food and the price. They should also make sure the restaurant is clean and safe. In addition, the location and the service are important.

2.answer:
When people choose a job, they think about many things, such as salary, working environment and career growth. Some people believe that salary is the most important factor, while others think job satisfaction matters more. In my opinion, job satisfaction is the most important factor when choosing a job.

Firstly, people spend about eight hours a day at work, so they should enjoy what they do. If they like their job, they feel happy and less stressed every day. For example, my friend Lan is a primary school teacher. Her salary is not high, but she loves children and always comes home with a smile. Secondly, people who enjoy their work usually work harder and learn faster. As a result, they often do their job well and get promoted. In addition, a satisfying job is good for health because people do not feel tired or worried all the time.

On the other hand, many people think that salary should come first. It is true that money is important because we need to pay for food, housing and our children's education. However, a high salary cannot make people happy if they hate their job. For instance, some bank staff earn a lot of money, but they work under great pressure and often feel exhausted. Moreover, if people are good at a job that they enjoy, their salary will usually increase over time.

In conclusion, salary, working environment and career growth are all important when people choose a job. However, I believe job satisfaction is the most important factor because it brings happiness, good results and good health. Young people should choose a job that they really enjoy.

I think my friend should practise speaking in front of a small group of friends. Let me explain why.

First, this option is the most similar to the real presentation. When she speaks in front of real people, she will feel a little nervous, just like on the big day. So she can learn how to control her nerves. Second, her friends can give her useful feedback. For example, they can tell her if she speaks too fast or if a slide is difficult to understand. They can also ask questions, so she can prepare her answers.

I don't choose practising in front of a mirror. It can help her check her body language, but nobody can give her feedback. Also, many people feel strange when they look at themselves for a long time. I also don't choose recording herself and listening back to the recording. This is useful for checking her voice, but it takes a lot of time. Moreover, there is no audience, so she will not feel the real pressure.

In conclusion, practising in front of a small group of friends is the best choice because it is realistic and she can get honest feedback.

Today I would like to talk about the impact of technology on learning. Technology brings many benefits, but in this talk I will focus on four problems.

First, many students have an over-reliance on technology. They use apps and AI tools for almost every task. For example, some students use AI to write their essays, so they do not really learn. When the internet is down, they cannot do anything.

Second, technology can lead to reduced critical thinking. Students can find answers on Google in a few seconds. As a result, they do not think deeply or ask why. In my job, I see that some young researchers believe everything on the screen without checking it.

Third, there is a problem of information overload. There is too much information online, and some of it is wrong. Students often feel confused and tired because they do not know which source to trust.

Finally, I think technology can cause health problems. Students look at screens for many hours every day. This can hurt their eyes and make it hard for them to sleep well.

In conclusion, technology is a useful tool for learning, but it can make students too dependent, reduce their critical thinking and cause stress and health problems. We should use it wisely.
follow_ups: No, I don't think so. Technology can support teachers, but it cannot replace them. Students still need teachers to guide them, encourage them and answer their questions.
People should set limits on their screen time. For example, they can try to solve a problem by themselves first before they search online. They should also read paper books more often.

Students need digital skills, such as searching for information quickly. They also need critical thinking skills to check if the information is true. In addition, they need good time management so they do not waste time online.

2.answer:
Nowadays, many children spend hours every day on smartphones, tablets and computers. This habit causes serious problems. Children may have poor eyesight and sleep badly. They may also become less active, get angry easily and do worse at school. This essay will discuss the main causes of this problem and suggest some possible solutions.

There are several reasons why children use electronic devices too much. Firstly, many parents are very busy with work. They give their children a phone or a tablet to keep them quiet. For example, it is common to see young children watching cartoons on a phone during meals. Secondly, games and social media apps are designed to be very attractive. As a result, children find it hard to stop playing or watching. In addition, many children have few places to play outside, especially in big cities. Therefore, a screen becomes their main form of entertainment.

Fortunately, there are some ways to reduce this problem. First, parents should set clear rules about screen time. For instance, children can use devices for only one hour a day after they finish their homework. Parents should also be good role models and put away their own phones at home. Second, schools should organise more outdoor activities and clubs, such as football, music and art. These activities help children make friends and stay active. Moreover, local governments should build more parks and playgrounds. When children have safe places to play, they will spend less time indoors.

In conclusion, children use electronic devices too much because their parents are busy, apps are attractive and there are few places to play. Parents, schools and governments should work together to solve this problem. With their help, children can grow up healthier and happier.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of failure in personal growth. Most people are afraid of failure, but I believe it can help us in many ways.

First, failure helps us learn valuable lessons from our mistakes. When we fail, we can see what we did wrong. For example, I failed my first driving test because I was too nervous. After that, I practised more and passed the second time.

Second, failure helps us build resilience and character. Life is not always easy, so we need to be strong. Each time we fail and stand up again, we become braver and more patient.

Third, failure can be a motivation for future success. Many famous people failed many times before they succeeded. For example, Thomas Edison failed thousands of times before he made a working light bulb. His failures pushed him to try harder.

Finally, I think failure helps us understand other people better. When we have experienced failure, we know how others feel when they fail. So we can encourage them and give them useful advice.

In conclusion, failure teaches us lessons, makes us stronger, motivates us and helps us understand others. We should not be afraid of failure. Instead, we should learn from it.

No, it is not always a bad thing. Failure can teach us important lessons and make us stronger. However, it is bad if we give up after we fail.

2.answer:
In recent years, more and more young people have visited historical sites, such as old temples, museums and ancient towns. This essay will discuss the main causes of this trend and its effects on society and the younger generation.

There are several reasons for this trend. Firstly, social media plays a big role. Many young people want to take beautiful photos at famous places like Hoi An Ancient Town and share them online. Secondly, history has become more interesting to young people. For example, films, games and TikTok videos about Vietnamese history are very popular nowadays. These stories make the past feel close and exciting. In addition, travelling has become cheaper and easier. Low-cost flights and buses now connect many cities. Students can find information and book tickets on their phones in a few minutes.

This trend has both positive and negative effects. On the positive side, young people learn more about the history and culture of their country. As a result, they feel proud of their nation and want to protect its heritage. Moreover, the trend brings money to local communities. Hotels, restaurants and souvenir shops near historical sites have more customers, so local people have more jobs. On the negative side, too many visitors can damage old buildings. Some tourists also leave rubbish or write on the walls. As a result, these sites may lose their original beauty.

In conclusion, young people visit historical sites because of social media, interesting history content and cheaper travel. This trend helps them understand their culture and supports local economies. However, the government should manage visitors carefully to protect these special places.

Today I would like to talk about the disadvantages of doing exercise. Exercise is good for our health, but it also has some disadvantages.

First, exercise can mean wasting time for busy people. For example, going to the gym can take about two hours, including travel time. Many office workers and students do not have that much free time, so they have less time for work, study or family.

Second, doing exercise can mean wasting money. Gym memberships, yoga classes and swimming pools are quite expensive in big cities. People also need to buy sports clothes, shoes and equipment. For instance, a good pair of running shoes can cost two million dong.

Third, there is a risk of getting injuries. If people exercise too hard or use the wrong technique, they can hurt their knees, backs or ankles. When I studied medicine, I saw many young people with knee injuries from playing football.

Finally, I think exercise can make people feel very tired and sore. After a hard workout, some people cannot concentrate at work the next day. This is especially true for beginners.

In conclusion, exercise can waste time and money, cause injuries and make people tired. However, these problems are small if we exercise in the right way.
follow_ups: They should warm up before exercising and cool down afterwards. They should also start slowly and wear suitable shoes. If they feel pain, they should stop immediately.

2.answer:
In many countries, children have to learn a foreign language at school from a very young age. Some people think this is a waste of time, while others strongly support it. In my opinion, foreign language lessons should be compulsory in schools for several reasons.

Firstly, a foreign language, especially English, is very useful for students' future. Many good companies want to hire people who can speak English. For example, in Vietnam, staff with good English skills often get higher salaries. Secondly, a foreign language helps students learn other subjects. Most information on the internet is in English, so students can read more books and articles and watch more videos. In addition, students who know a foreign language can study abroad more easily. For instance, many Vietnamese students now win scholarships to study in Australia or Japan.

Moreover, it is better to start learning a language when children are young. Young children can copy sounds and remember new words quickly. As a result, they can speak with a better accent than adults. Learning a language also helps children understand other cultures and become more open-minded. For example, they can enjoy foreign films and make friends from other countries. Some people say that language lessons take time away from important subjects like maths and science. However, schools can plan the timetable carefully, and three lessons a week are enough.

In conclusion, I strongly believe that foreign language lessons should be compulsory in schools. They give students better job chances, more knowledge and a wider view of the world. Schools should also make these lessons fun and practical so that students enjoy them.

I think our class should try beef noodle soup, or Pho Bo, together. Let me explain why.

Second, pho is quick and easy for a big group. A pho restaurant can serve thirty bowls in a few minutes, so we will not waste time. It is also cheap, about fifty thousand dong a bowl, so every student can afford it. In addition, the weather in Hanoi is often cool, and a hot bowl of pho is perfect.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of traveling in a group. In my opinion, group travel has four main benefits.

First, traveling in a group helps us save money. We can share the cost of hotel rooms, taxis and food. For example, last year I went to Da Lat with five friends. We rented a big house together, and each person paid much less than for a single hotel room.

Second, group travel brings increased safety. When we go to a new place, there are always some risks, such as getting lost or losing our bags. In a group, members can look after each other. If someone gets sick, others can help them or take them to a hospital.

Third, we can share experiences with others. A beautiful view or a delicious meal is more enjoyable when we share it with friends. After the trip, we have many shared memories and photos to talk about.

Finally, I think group travel is a great way of making new friends. In a tour group, we often meet people from different places. Some of them may become our close friends later.

In conclusion, traveling in a group helps us save money, stay safe, share experiences and make new friends. That is why I often travel in a group.
follow_ups: I prefer traveling in a group. It is safer and more fun, and I can share the cost with my friends. However, sometimes I travel alone when I need some quiet time.

The biggest challenge is that people have different opinions. For example, some people want to go shopping, but others want to visit museums. Also, the group often moves slowly because we have to wait for each other.

When we travel together, we spend a lot of time talking and helping each other. We also face small problems together, like getting lost. As a result, we understand each other better and become closer.

Dear Bill,

Thank you for your email. I am glad to help with your article about tour guiding in Vietnam. I live in Ho Chi Minh City.

The city has many highlights. First, there is a lot of delicious and cheap street food, such as pho, banh mi and broken rice. Second, visitors can see famous places like Ben Thanh Market and the Central Post Office. In addition, the city is very lively at night, especially on Nguyen Hue Walking Street.

Many people believe that Ho Chi Minh City is only a busy business city with no history. This is not true. The city is more than 300 years old, and it has many old pagodas and French buildings. For example, Notre-Dame Cathedral was completed in 1880.

In your article, you should also mention the weather and the traffic. The best time to visit is from December to April because it rarely rains. Also, there are millions of motorbikes, so tourists should cross the street slowly and carefully.

I hope this information is useful. Please send me your article when it is finished.

2.answer:
Many people today find it hard to remember things, such as names, passwords or important tasks. This problem is often caused by bad habits and a lack of knowledge about brain health. This essay will discuss the problems related to poor memory and suggest some ways to improve it.

Poor memory can cause many problems in daily life. Firstly, students with a weak memory often get low marks because they cannot remember what they have studied. Secondly, poor memory affects people's work. For example, an office worker may forget a meeting or make mistakes with numbers. In addition, memory problems are often a result of unhealthy habits. Many people sleep too little, eat junk food and spend hours on their phones, so their brains become tired.

Fortunately, there are several measures that can help people improve and maintain a good memory. First, people should exercise regularly. Walking, swimming or cycling for thirty minutes a day sends more blood to the brain. Second, people need enough sleep and a healthy diet. Adults should sleep seven to eight hours a night and eat more fish, nuts and vegetables. Moreover, people should keep their brains active. For instance, they can read books, learn a new language or play chess. These activities help the brain stay strong, even in old age.

In conclusion, poor memory can affect people's studies and work, and it is often caused by bad habits. However, people can improve their memory by exercising, sleeping well, eating healthy food and training their brain. Simple daily changes can make a big difference.

I think my friend should become a nutritionist. There are two main reasons.

First, this job matches her interests and her studies. My friend, Lan, studied food science at university, and she loves cooking healthy meals. She often gives me advice about what to eat. Second, nutritionists are in high demand nowadays. Many people in Vietnam have problems like obesity and diabetes because of their unhealthy diets. So hospitals, gyms and schools need nutritionists to help people eat better. As a result, she can find a job easily and earn a good salary.

I don't choose becoming a healthcare worker. This job is very meaningful, but it usually needs a medical or nursing degree, and Lan does not have one. Healthcare workers also often work long night shifts, so they can feel very tired. I also don't choose becoming a counselor. A counselor needs special training in psychology. Moreover, listening to other people's problems every day can be very stressful.

In conclusion, becoming a nutritionist is the best choice for Lan because it suits her knowledge and interests, and there are many job opportunities.

Today I would like to talk about the benefits of taking part in extracurricular activities. These are activities outside the classroom, such as sports clubs, music clubs and volunteer work.

First, students can learn more skills. For example, in a debate club, students learn how to speak in public and think quickly. In a volunteer group, they learn teamwork and leadership. These skills are very useful for their future jobs.

Second, extracurricular activities help students balance their academic and personal life. Studying all day can be very stressful. When students join a club they enjoy, they can relax and have fun. As a result, they feel happier and study better.

Third, these activities help students build social relationships. They can meet new people who have the same interests. When I was a university student, I joined a swimming club. Many members of that club are still my close friends today.

Finally, I think extracurricular activities can improve students' physical health. Many activities, like football, dancing or swimming, keep students active. This is important because students often sit for many hours in class and at home.

In conclusion, extracurricular activities help students learn new skills, reduce stress, make friends and stay healthy. Every student should try at least one activity.

2.answer:
In recent years, renewable energy sources such as wind and solar power have become more and more popular. Many governments and companies are spending a lot of money on them to protect the environment. This essay will discuss the advantages and disadvantages of these green energy sources.

On the one hand, green energy has several important advantages. Firstly, it is clean. Wind and solar power do not produce smoke or carbon dioxide, so they help reduce air pollution and climate change. Secondly, these energy sources will never run out. The sun shines and the wind blows every day, while coal and oil will be used up one day. In addition, green energy can save money in the long term. For example, many families in Vietnam have put solar panels on their roofs, and their electricity bills are now much lower.

On the other hand, green energy also has some disadvantages. Firstly, building solar farms and wind farms is very expensive at the beginning. Poor countries may not have enough money for these projects. Secondly, green energy depends on the weather. Solar panels produce little electricity on cloudy days and none at night. Similarly, wind turbines stop when there is no wind. Moreover, these projects need a lot of land. For instance, large solar farms in Ninh Thuan cover land that farmers could use for crops.

In conclusion, wind and solar power are clean, renewable and cheap to use, but they are expensive to build and they depend on the weather. I believe governments should continue to invest in green energy and also find better ways to store electricity.

When he works, he will learn practical skills and understand his field better. Second, he can earn his own money and become independent. He will not need to ask his parents for money anymore. 3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the qualities that a good teacher should have. I think there are four important qualities.

First, a good teacher needs creativity in teaching methods. Creative teachers use games, videos and group projects to make lessons interesting. For example, my high school English teacher often used songs to teach us new words. Because of her, I started to love English.

Second, a good teacher should have patience with students. Students learn at different speeds, and some of them need more time. A patient teacher explains things again and never makes students feel stupid.

Third, a good teacher must have extensive knowledge of the subject. When teachers know their subject well, they can answer difficult questions and give clear examples. Students also trust and respect them more.

Finally, I think a good teacher needs good communication skills. Teachers must explain ideas clearly and listen to their students. Good communication also helps them work with parents and other teachers.

In conclusion, a good teacher should be creative, patient, knowledgeable and good at communication. These qualities help students learn well and enjoy going to school.
follow_ups: I think patience is the most important quality. Without patience, a teacher cannot help weak students. A patient teacher also makes students feel safe and confident.
Creative teachers make lessons fun, so students pay more attention. As a result, students remember the lessons longer. They also become more creative themselves.
Yes, I think so. Today, teachers need good technology skills because students learn with computers and the internet. They also need to teach students how to check information online.

2.answer:
Fast food is now a part of modern life, but it is linked to many health problems, such as obesity and poor nutrition. Because of this, some people think that fast food should be banned completely. Although I understand their worries, I disagree with this idea.

Firstly, banning fast food would take away people's freedom of choice. Adults should be able to decide what they eat. Eating a burger once or twice a month is not harmful. The real problem is eating too much of it. Secondly, fast food is very convenient for busy people. For example, many office workers in big cities only have thirty minutes for lunch, so they need quick meals. In addition, a ban would hurt the economy. Thousands of people work in fast food restaurants, and they would lose their jobs.

Instead of a ban, there are better ways to reduce the problems of fast food. First, schools and parents should teach children about healthy eating. When children understand the harm of too much fat and sugar, they will make better choices. For example, they may choose water instead of soft drinks. Second, governments can control fast food in other ways. For instance, they can add a tax on sugary drinks and stop fast food advertisements on children's TV programmes. Moreover, fast food companies should offer healthier options, such as salads, fruit and grilled chicken.

In conclusion, I disagree that fast food should be banned. A ban would limit people's freedom, cause inconvenience and lead to job losses. Education, clear rules and healthier menus are better ways to protect people's health.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of protecting the environment. I think there are four main benefits.

First, protecting the environment leads to improved public health. When the air and water are clean, people have fewer diseases. For example, air pollution in big cities causes many breathing problems. With my medical background, I know that clean air can reduce asthma and lung disease.

Second, there are many economic benefits. A clean environment attracts tourists, so local people can earn more money. Places like Ha Long Bay and Phu Quoc are famous because of their beautiful nature. In addition, when people are healthy, the government spends less money on health care.

Third, protecting the environment means the preservation of natural resources for future generations. If we cut down all the forests and use up all the clean water now, our children will have nothing left. We should use these resources carefully.

Finally, I think protecting the environment helps protect wildlife. Many animals, such as elephants and turtles, are losing their homes because of pollution and deforestation. A clean environment gives them a safe place to live.

In conclusion, protecting the environment is good for our health, our economy, our children and wildlife. Everyone should do something small to help.
follow_ups: Individuals can do many small things. For example, they can use less plastic, save electricity and recycle their rubbish. They can also take buses instead of using private cars.
I think governments are trying, but they are not doing enough. Many rivers and cities are still very polluted. They should make stricter laws and punish companies that pollute the environment.
Environmental protection creates new jobs, for example in recycling and solar energy. It also attracts more tourists. In addition, healthy people can work better, so the economy grows.

2.answer:
Over the past ten years, social media platforms such as Facebook, Zalo and TikTok have grown very quickly. Today, people of all ages use them every day. This essay will discuss how this growth has changed the way people communicate, both positively and negatively.

On the one hand, social media has had several positive effects on communication. Firstly, people can contact each other quickly and cheaply. For example, I can send messages or make free video calls to my cousin in Australia at any time. Secondly, social media helps people keep in touch with old friends. Many people have found classmates that they lost contact with years ago. In addition, shy people often find it easier to share their ideas online. As a result, they feel more confident and connected.

On the other hand, social media has also had negative effects. Firstly, people talk face to face less often. It is common to see a family at dinner where everyone is looking at their phone. Secondly, online messages are often short and informal. Some young people use emojis and slang so much that they find it hard to write formal emails. For example, some students write to their teachers in the same way as they chat with friends. Moreover, misunderstandings happen more easily online. Without tone of voice and body language, a short message can sound rude or cold.

In conclusion, the growth of social media has made communication faster, cheaper and more convenient. However, it has also reduced face-to-face conversations and weakened some communication skills. I believe people should use social media wisely and spend more real time with their family and friends.

2.answer:
I think the best option is to encourage children to take part in alternative activities, such as sports or reading. Let me explain why.

First, this option solves the real problem. Many children play video games because they are bored and have nothing else to do. When they have other interesting activities, they will naturally spend less time on games. Second, sports and reading are very good for children. Sports keep them fit and healthy, and they also learn teamwork. Reading helps them improve their language and imagination. In addition, parents can join these activities with their children, so the family becomes closer.

I don't choose setting strict daily time limits for playing video games. It can work for a while, but children often argue with their parents about the rules. When the time is up, they may feel bored and angry. I also don't choose completely banning video games at home. This is too strict. Some games are educational, and children may feel left out when their friends talk about games. Moreover, they may play secretly at a friend's house.

In conclusion, encouraging children to take part in alternative activities is the best choice because it is positive and healthy, and it helps the whole family.

3.answer:
Today I would like to introduce my city, Ho Chi Minh City. If a club asked me to choose between a famous event and a well-known place, I would choose a well-known place. However, I will talk about four things that make my city special.

First, there are many famous landmarks and attractions. Visitors can see the Central Post Office, Notre-Dame Cathedral and Ben Thanh Market. These places are open all year, so visitors can see them at any time. That is the main reason why I choose a well-known place.

Second, my city has many interesting local events and festivals. For example, during Tet, Nguyen Hue Street becomes a big flower street. However, these events only happen once a year, so many visitors cannot see them.

Third, visitors can enjoy cultural and culinary experiences. They can try street food such as banh mi, broken rice and pho. They can also watch a water puppet show or take a cooking class.

Finally, I think nightlife and shopping are also big attractions. The city is busy until midnight. Visitors can walk along Bui Vien Walking Street or go shopping at night markets.

In conclusion, my city has famous places, colourful festivals, great food and an exciting nightlife. However, I believe well-known places are the best way to introduce it because visitors can enjoy them at any time.

2.answer:
Nowadays, many people spend their free time chatting with colleagues and classmates on social media instead of meeting their close friends. As a result, some people have hundreds of online friends. In my opinion, having lots of online friends has both advantages and disadvantages, and this essay will discuss both sides.

On the one hand, having many online friends brings several benefits. Firstly, people can learn new things from others. For example, I follow many doctors and researchers online, and they often share useful articles. Secondly, online friends can help us with work and study. Students can ask their classmates about homework, and employees can find job opportunities through their contacts. In addition, social media is cheap and convenient. People can keep in touch with friends in other cities or countries without spending much money.

On the other hand, having too many online friends also causes some problems. Firstly, online friendships are often not deep. People only click 'like' or send short messages, so they do not really care for each other. Secondly, people may spend less time with their real friends and family. As a result, they can feel lonely even when they have hundreds of friends online. Moreover, it can be unsafe to share personal information with strangers. Some people pretend to be friends, but they want to cheat others or steal their money.

In conclusion, having lots of online friends can help us learn, work and stay connected. However, it can also make our relationships shallow and put our safety at risk. I believe we should use social media wisely. We should spend more time with the close friends who truly matter to us.

I think my friend should teach at a public school in her hometown. Let me explain why.

First, she can live with her family. She does not need to pay rent, and the cost of living in her hometown is much lower. As a result, she can save money from her first salary. Second, she will feel less stress. Her hometown is quiet and there are no traffic jams, so she will have more time to prepare her lessons. In addition, she can help the children in her hometown. Many schools in small towns need good young teachers, and she knows the local people well.

I don't choose teaching at a public school in a big city because life in a big city is very expensive. The salary at a public school is almost the same everywhere, but she will spend a lot of money on rent and transport. I also don't choose teaching at an international school in a big city. 3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about student misbehavior. These days, more students break school rules, fight or bully their classmates. In my opinion, there are four main reasons for this problem.

First, school discipline is not strict enough in some schools. Some teachers are too busy, so they do not notice bad behavior. When students break the rules and nothing happens, they will do it again.

Second, family background plays an important role. Many parents work long hours and have little time for their children. Some children live in families with a lot of arguments. As a result, they may feel angry and behave badly at school.

Third, the internet has a strong effect on students. Many teenagers watch violent videos or play violent games online. They may copy this behavior in real life. Moreover, some students use social media to post bad comments about their classmates.

Finally, I think peer pressure is another reason. Teenagers want to be accepted by their friends. If their friends skip classes or smoke, they may do the same thing to fit in.

In conclusion, student misbehavior comes from the school, the family, the internet and friends. Schools and parents should work together to solve this problem.
follow_ups: There are many sorts of misbehavior, such as talking in class, cheating in exams and skipping classes. More serious types are fighting and bullying other students. Some students also use their phones during lessons.
I think parents are the most responsible. Children learn their first lessons about behavior at home. However, teachers also need to guide students at school.

Dear Sarah,

2.answer:
In recent years, many countries have spent a lot of money on alternative energy, such as solar, wind and hydroelectric power. However, some people say that this trend also has drawbacks. In my opinion, the increasing use of alternative energy is a positive development, although it has some problems.

Firstly, alternative energy is much better for the environment. Solar panels and wind turbines do not produce smoke or carbon dioxide. As a result, the air becomes cleaner and climate change slows down. Secondly, these energy sources will never run out. Coal and oil will be used up one day, but the sun and the wind are always there. In addition, alternative energy creates new jobs. For example, in Vietnam, many workers now build and repair solar farms in Ninh Thuan province.

On the other hand, I agree that alternative energy has some drawbacks. Firstly, building solar farms and wind farms is very expensive at the beginning. However, the cost is falling every year, and the energy from the sun and wind is free. Secondly, solar and wind power depend on the weather. There is no solar power at night and very little on cloudy days, but scientists are solving this problem with better batteries. Moreover, large dams for hydroelectric power can damage rivers and force people to move. Governments should plan these projects carefully to protect local people.

In conclusion, alternative energy has some disadvantages, such as high costs and weather problems. However, its benefits for the environment and the economy are much greater. Therefore, I believe it is a positive development, and governments should continue to invest in it.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about effective ways to stay healthy in daily life. In my opinion, there are four simple ways.

First, we should do regular exercise. We do not need to go to an expensive gym. For example, I go swimming every weekend, and I often walk to the coffee shop near my house. Exercise makes our heart and muscles stronger.

Second, eating healthy food is very important. We should eat more vegetables, fruit and fish, and less fast food and sugar. With my medical background, I know that many people get diabetes because of bad eating habits.

Third, we need to manage stress effectively. Too much stress can cause headaches and sleeping problems. We can reduce stress by reading books, listening to music or talking with friends. I usually meet my friends at a coffee shop at the weekend, and it helps me relax.

Finally, I think getting enough sleep is also necessary. Adults should sleep seven to eight hours every night. When we sleep well, our body can recover and our brain works better.

In conclusion, regular exercise, healthy food, less stress and enough sleep can help us stay healthy. These habits are simple, but we must follow them every day.
follow_ups: I think swimming is one of the most effective types of exercise. It uses all the muscles in the body, and it is good for the heart. Besides, it does not hurt your knees like running.
Stress affects both the body and the mind. People under stress often have headaches, high blood pressure and sleeping problems. They may also feel sad and tired all the time.

No, I don't think most young people pay enough attention to their health. Many of them stay up late, eat fast food and sit in front of screens all day. However, some young people now go to the gym and eat more healthily.

2.answer:
In many families, mothers still do most of the housework, such as cooking, cleaning and looking after children. However, more and more families now share these chores among all members. In my opinion, this change brings many advantages for both parents and children.

Firstly, sharing housework reduces the burden on mothers. Many mothers today have full-time jobs, so doing all the chores after work makes them very tired. When the father and the children help, the mother has more time to rest and look after her health. She will also feel happier and less stressed. Secondly, sharing chores is fair. Both parents work, so both of them should be responsible for the home. As a result, women have more chances to develop their careers. For example, my aunt was able to finish her master's degree because my uncle started cooking dinner every day.

In addition, sharing chores is very good for children. Firstly, children learn important life skills. If they can cook simple meals, wash clothes and clean their rooms, they will be more independent when they grow up. They can easily live on their own when they go to university. Secondly, doing chores teaches children responsibility. They understand that everyone must help the family. Moreover, working together makes family members closer. For instance, cooking dinner together gives families a chance to talk and laugh. There are also fewer arguments about housework.

In conclusion, sharing household chores helps mothers feel less tired, makes the family fairer and teaches children useful skills. It also brings family members closer together. Therefore, I believe every family should share the housework instead of leaving it to the mother alone.

Today I would like to talk about effective solutions to reduce obesity in modern society. Obesity is a serious problem because it can lead to diabetes and heart disease. In my opinion, there are four main solutions.

First, people should eat less fast food. Fast food such as fried chicken, burgers and pizza has a lot of fat, salt and sugar. If we eat it only once a week, we will take in fewer calories.

Second, exercising regularly is very important. Adults should do at least thirty minutes of exercise every day. For example, I go swimming at weekends, and I take the stairs instead of the lift. Exercise helps us burn fat and stay fit.

Third, cooking meals at home is a good solution. When we cook at home, we can choose fresh vegetables, lean meat and less oil. Home-cooked meals are also cheaper than eating out. My mother always cooks dinner for our family, and nobody in my family is overweight.

Finally, I think health education at school can help. Schools should teach children about healthy food and the dangers of obesity. Children who learn good habits early will keep them when they grow up.

In conclusion, eating less fast food, exercising regularly, cooking at home and health education can help to reduce obesity. Both the government and individuals need to take action.

Many people choose fast food because it is quick and convenient. They are busy with work and do not have time to cook. In addition, fast food is tasty and quite cheap.
Fast food can cause heart disease, high blood pressure and diabetes. It can also cause stomach problems because it has a lot of oil. In the long term, people may feel tired and unhealthy.

2.answer:
Many people buy a new phone or a fashionable jacket only because a friend has bought the same thing. Some people think that copying others' choices is a natural part of human behavior. In my opinion, this is partly true, but people should still think carefully before they buy something.

On the one hand, there are good reasons to believe that this habit is natural. Firstly, humans are social animals, and we want to belong to a group. When we wear the same style as our friends, we feel accepted. Secondly, we trust the experience of people we know. For example, if my friend says her new phone has a great camera, I believe her more than an advertisement. In addition, copying others saves time. There are thousands of products in the shops, so following a friend's choice makes shopping easier.

On the other hand, some people argue that this behavior is not only natural. Firstly, it is strongly influenced by advertising and social media. Companies pay famous people to use their products because they know that fans will copy them. Secondly, copying others can cause problems. Some young people buy expensive things they do not need just to look like their friends. As a result, they waste money or even get into debt. Moreover, people can learn to control this habit. Many people make a budget and only buy things that are useful for them.

In conclusion, I believe that copying others' choices is a natural part of human behavior to some extent. However, it is also affected by advertising, and it can lead to waste. Therefore, we should think about our real needs before we follow other people.

I think the company should choose a rural campsite for its annual team-building event. Let me explain why.

First, a rural campsite is far from the noisy city. Employees can enjoy fresh air, green fields and a peaceful atmosphere. After a stressful year at work, this will help them relax. Second, a campsite is perfect for team activities. Staff can play group games, set up tents and cook meals together. These activities require teamwork, so colleagues will learn to cooperate and trust each other. In addition, they can stay overnight and sit around a campfire in the evening. As a result, they will have more time to talk and become closer.

I don't choose a theme park. It is fun, but it is usually crowded and the tickets are expensive. Moreover, employees often split into small groups to go on different rides, so there is not much teamwork. I also don't choose a riverbank area. It is beautiful, but there is not enough space for big group games. Playing near the water can also be dangerous for some people.

In conclusion, a rural campsite is the best choice because it is relaxing, and it helps employees work as a real team.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of training programs for employees. In my opinion, these programs bring four main benefits.

First, training programs improve job performance and skills. Employees can learn new knowledge and new software. For example, my research team recently took a course about AI tools for medical data. After the course, we could analyse data much faster.

Second, training boosts employee confidence and motivation. When workers know how to do their jobs well, they feel more confident. They also feel that the company cares about them, so they are more motivated to work hard.

Third, training increases company productivity and growth. Skilled employees make fewer mistakes and finish their work faster. As a result, the company can serve more customers and earn more money.

Finally, I think training helps companies keep good employees. Many young people want a job where they can learn and grow. If a company offers good training, its staff will not want to leave. This saves the company a lot of money on hiring new people.

In conclusion, training programs help both employees and companies. They improve skills, confidence, productivity and staff loyalty. Therefore, training is a good investment for every company.

Yes, I think all companies should invest in training. Even a small company can organize short online courses for its staff. In the long term, the company will benefit from skilled and loyal workers.

2.answer:
Nowadays, conflicts between parents and their teenage children are becoming more common. These conflicts cause serious problems. Teenagers may feel lonely and stressed, and some of them do badly at school. Family relationships can also become very weak. This essay will discuss the main causes of these conflicts and suggest some possible solutions.

There are several causes of this problem. Firstly, there is a generation gap between parents and teenagers. Parents grew up without smartphones and social media, so they often do not understand their children's lifestyle. Secondly, many parents have very high expectations. They want their children to get high marks and enter a famous university. As a result, teenagers feel stressed and argue with their parents. In addition, poor communication is a big cause. Parents are often busy with work, while teenagers spend most of their free time on their phones. They rarely talk to each other, so small problems become big arguments.

However, there are some effective solutions. Firstly, parents and children should spend more time talking and listening to each other. For example, families can have dinner together every evening without phones. Secondly, parents should respect their children's privacy and give them some freedom. They can agree on clear rules, such as coming home before 10 p.m. Moreover, teenagers should also try to understand their parents, who work hard and want the best for them. Finally, schools can organize workshops to teach parents and students how to communicate better.

In conclusion, conflicts between parents and teenagers are caused by the generation gap, high expectations and poor communication. These conflicts hurt both teenagers and parents, but they can be solved if both sides talk more, respect each other and agree on clear rules. A happy family needs effort from everyone.

I think the best way is to promote the city through social media. Let me explain why.

The city can create its own pages and post photos and short videos almost for free. In addition, social media content spreads very quickly. I don't choose advertising through TV and radio. TV adverts are very expensive, and fewer young people watch TV nowadays. Radio is even worse because listeners cannot see the beautiful pictures of the city. I also don't choose writing engaging content such as travel blogs and articles. In conclusion, promoting the city through social media is the best choice because it is cheap and fast, and it can reach a lot of people.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about effective ways to reduce crime rates in society. In my opinion, there are four main ways.

First, the government should install security cameras in public areas. Cameras in streets, parks and bus stations help the police watch these places all the time. Criminals are also afraid of being recorded, so they commit fewer crimes.

Second, some people think we need more prisons and stricter punishment. If punishments are serious, people will think twice before they break the law. However, prisons alone cannot solve the problem, because some prisoners commit crimes again after they leave.

Third, improving education and awareness is very important. Schools should teach children about the law and about right and wrong. In addition, TV and social media can warn people about common tricks, such as online scams.

Finally, I think creating more jobs can reduce crime. Many people steal because they are poor and have no job. If the government offers job training and more jobs, fewer people will turn to crime.

In conclusion, security cameras, stricter punishment, education and more jobs can all help to reduce crime. The best result will come when we use all of these ways together.

2.answer:
Historical exhibitions show visitors objects, documents and stories from the past. Some people believe that visiting these exhibitions brings many benefits. I completely agree with this view because historical exhibitions help us learn and also bring benefits to society.

Firstly, historical exhibitions broaden our knowledge of history. Visitors can see real objects, such as old weapons, clothes and tools. This makes history more real and easier to remember than a textbook. Secondly, exhibitions help us understand our culture. For example, at the Museum of Vietnamese History in Ho Chi Minh City, I learned about the traditional clothes and customs of many ethnic groups. As a result, I felt proud of my country. In addition, exhibitions teach us important lessons from the past. After visiting the War Remnants Museum, many people understand the terrible effects of war and the value of peace.

Moreover, historical exhibitions are good for families and society. Firstly, they are a healthy and educational activity for families at weekends. Parents can take their children there instead of letting them play games on their phones all day. Secondly, exhibitions attract tourists. Foreign visitors want to learn about the history of the places they visit, so they spend money on tickets, food and souvenirs. This helps the local economy. Finally, exhibitions help to protect history for future generations. When many people visit, the government has more money to look after old objects.

In conclusion, I strongly believe that visiting historical exhibitions is beneficial. They help people learn about history and culture, and they also support families and the economy. Therefore, everyone should visit historical exhibitions more often.

2.answer:
I think the company should arrange outdoor team-building activities. Let me explain why.

First, these activities can improve both skills and well-being at the same time. Staff can learn important soft skills, such as teamwork, communication and leadership. For example, in a group game, they must plan together and support each other. Second, outdoor activities are good for health. Employees can enjoy fresh air, move their bodies and forget about work for a while. As a result, they feel less stressed and more energetic. In addition, team-building helps colleagues become closer. After the event, they will work together more easily.

I don't choose skill-building workshops. They are useful for skills, but they do not help much with well-being. Employees may also feel tired if they have to sit in another long session after work. I also don't choose online learning courses. They are flexible and cheap, but employees already spend many hours in front of a computer. Online courses can make them more tired, and there is little interaction with colleagues.

In conclusion, outdoor team-building activities are the best choice because they help employees learn new skills and feel healthier and happier.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about what companies should consider when hiring new employees. In my opinion, there are four important things.

First, companies should look at qualifications and technical skills. A candidate needs the right degree and knowledge to do the job well. For example, a hospital must hire doctors with a medical degree and a licence. In my research team, we need people who can use AI and data software.

Second, soft skills and attitude are very important. Soft skills include communication, teamwork and problem-solving. A good attitude means the person is hard-working, honest and willing to learn. Technical skills can be taught, but a bad attitude is very difficult to change.

Third, companies should think about cultural fit within the company. Every company has its own values and working style. If a new employee shares these values, he or she will feel comfortable and stay longer.

Finally, I think work experience also matters. Experienced candidates can start working quickly and need less training. However, companies should also give young graduates a chance.

In conclusion, qualifications, soft skills, cultural fit and work experience are all important. A good company should consider all of them before choosing a new employee.
follow_ups: I think confidence and good preparation make a candidate stand out. A good candidate knows a lot about the company and answers questions clearly. A friendly smile also leaves a good impression.
In my opinion, companies should prioritize potential for most positions. Young people with potential can learn fast and bring new ideas. However, for senior jobs, experience is more important.
The hiring process has changed a lot because of technology. Many companies now post jobs online and do interviews on Zoom. Some companies even use AI to read CVs.

Hi Mark,

Thanks for your email. I am really happy that you are coming to my hometown, Buon Ma Thuot, next month!

There are many places to go shopping here. In the city centre, there is a big shopping mall with clothes shops, a supermarket and a cinema. If you want something more local, you should visit the central market. You can buy fresh fruit, souvenirs and, of course, the famous Dak Lak coffee at good prices.

2.answer:
Motorbikes are one of the most popular means of transport in many countries, especially in crowded cities like Ho Chi Minh City. They are convenient for daily travel, but they also cause some worries about safety and the environment. This essay will discuss both the advantages and disadvantages of riding motorbikes.

On the one hand, motorbikes bring several benefits. Firstly, they are cheap to buy and to use. A new motorbike costs much less than a car, and it uses very little fuel. As a result, most families can afford one. Secondly, motorbikes are very convenient and flexible. Riders can go through small streets and park almost anywhere. For example, I can ride my motorbike from home to my office in only twenty minutes, even during rush hour. In addition, motorbikes save time in traffic jams. They can move between cars, so riders often arrive earlier than car drivers.

On the other hand, riding motorbikes also has some disadvantages. Firstly, it is not very safe. Motorbike riders are not protected like car drivers, so accidents can cause serious injuries. Secondly, millions of motorbikes produce a lot of smoke and noise. This makes the air in big cities dirty and causes health problems, such as asthma. Moreover, riding a motorbike can be uncomfortable. Riders have to deal with hot sun, heavy rain and dust every day.

In conclusion, motorbikes are cheap, convenient and fast, but they can be dangerous and harmful to the environment. In my opinion, people should ride carefully and always wear a good helmet. The government should also encourage electric motorbikes and better public transport.

I think the family should enroll their child in a public school. Let me explain why.

First, public schools are much cheaper. The family can save a lot of money and use it for other things, such as English classes, books or sports. Second, there is usually a public school near home. The child can go to school by bike, so the family saves time every day. In addition, many public schools in big cities have very good teachers. Students also make friends with children from many different backgrounds, so they learn how to get along with different people. For example, my cousin studies at a public secondary school in District 3, and she is one of the best students in the city.

I don't choose an international school. It has modern facilities and a lot of English, but the school fees are extremely high. The quality of private schools is also different from school to school, so it is hard to choose a good one.

In conclusion, a public school is the best choice because it is cheap and convenient, and it gives the child a good education.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of investing in art. In my opinion, there are four main benefits.

First, art has economic value and can bring long-term financial returns. The price of a good painting often increases over time. For example, some paintings by famous Vietnamese artists now sell for millions of dollars at international auctions. So buying art can be a good way to save money for the future.

Second, investing in art helps to preserve culture and history. Paintings, statues and traditional crafts show how people lived in the past. When people buy and look after these works, they keep them for future generations.

Third, investing in art supports artists and creative industries. Many young artists find it difficult to earn a living. When people buy their works, artists can continue to create. In addition, the art industry creates jobs in galleries, design and tourism.

Finally, I think art can improve people's mental health. Looking at beautiful paintings makes people feel calm and happy. With my medical background, I know that some hospitals now use art to help patients reduce stress.

In conclusion, investing in art brings money, protects culture, supports artists and improves our mental health. Therefore, both individuals and governments should invest more in art.

2.answer:
Public transport, such as buses, trains and subways, plays an important role in modern cities. Millions of people use it every day instead of private vehicles. However, it also has some limitations. This essay will discuss both the advantages and disadvantages of public transport.

On the one hand, public transport has many benefits. Firstly, it helps to reduce traffic jams. One bus can carry fifty people, while fifty people on motorbikes take up a lot of road space. Secondly, it is better for the environment. When fewer private vehicles are on the road, there is less smoke, so the air becomes cleaner. In addition, public transport is cheap. For example, a bus ticket in Ho Chi Minh City costs only a few thousand dong. This is much cheaper than petrol and parking fees. Passengers can also read or rest during the trip instead of driving.

On the other hand, public transport has some disadvantages. Firstly, buses and trains are often overcrowded, especially during rush hour. Passengers may have to stand for a long time in a hot and noisy space. Secondly, there are often delays. Buses can get stuck in traffic, so people may be late for work or school. Moreover, public transport does not cover all areas. In many suburbs and rural areas, there are no bus stops near people's homes, so they still need a motorbike.

In conclusion, public transport can reduce traffic, protect the environment and save money, but it can be crowded, slow and limited. In my opinion, its benefits are greater. The government should invest more in buses and metro lines to make them more comfortable and reliable.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the positive effects of volunteering on young people's personal development. In my opinion, there are four main points.

First, there are many types of volunteer activities for young people. They can teach poor children, clean beaches, plant trees or help at hospitals. For example, when I was a student, I volunteered at a hospital in Ho Chi Minh City. I helped old patients fill in forms and find the right rooms.

Second, young people gain many personal skills and grow as people. They learn teamwork, communication and problem-solving. They also become more confident and responsible. Many volunteers say that they understand themselves better after a volunteer trip.

Third, volunteering brings benefits for the community and society. Volunteers help people in need, such as poor families, old people and sick children. They also help to protect the environment. As a result, society becomes kinder and better.

Finally, I think volunteering can help young people with their careers. Employers like candidates who have volunteer experience on their CV. In addition, volunteers can meet new people and find job opportunities.

In conclusion, volunteering gives young people useful skills and better career chances. It also helps the community and society. Therefore, I think every young person should try volunteering at least once.
follow_ups: Young people should volunteer because it helps them grow. They can learn new skills and understand the difficulties of other people. It is also a good way to use their free time.

Volunteers may have problems with time and money. Some activities are in remote areas, so the trips can be tiring. In addition, volunteers sometimes feel sad when they see people in difficult situations.
I think schools should encourage volunteer work, but not require it. If students are forced to volunteer, they may not enjoy it. However, schools can offer many activities and give small rewards.

2.answer:
Nowadays, more and more students bring mobile phones to school, and even many secondary school pupils have their own phones. Some people think this is a good idea, but many teachers believe that phones do more harm than good. In my opinion, students should be allowed to bring phones to school, but schools need clear rules.

On the one hand, there are several reasons why phones can be useful for students. Firstly, phones help students stay in touch with their parents. For example, a child can call his mother if he feels sick or if school finishes late. Secondly, phones are useful learning tools. Students can look up new words in an online dictionary or search for information for a project. In addition, many teachers now use apps such as Quizlet or Kahoot. These apps make lessons more interesting and help students remember new information.

On the other hand, many teachers argue that phones cause serious problems at school. Firstly, phones distract students during lessons. Many pupils play games or check social media instead of listening to the teacher. Secondly, some students use their phones to cheat in tests, and this is unfair to other students. Moreover, students who spend a lot of time on their phones talk less with their classmates. As a result, they may feel lonely and have weaker social skills.

In conclusion, mobile phones can help students stay safe and learn better, but they can also distract them and lead to cheating. I believe schools should not ban phones completely. Instead, students should keep their phones in their bags during lessons and use them only when their teachers allow it.

2.answer:
I think the best farewell gift for my friend is a framed photograph. Let me explain why.

First, a photo is full of memories. I will choose a photo of our group of friends on a trip to Da Lat. When my friend looks at it, she will remember our happy time together. Second, it can help her feel less homesick. Living in a new country is not easy, and she may feel lonely at first. A photo of her friends on her desk will make her feel warm and loved. In addition, a framed photograph is a very personal gift. Nobody else can give her the same one.

I don't choose a wristwatch because it is quite expensive. Also, many people now check the time on their phones. My friend can easily buy a nice watch in the United States if she needs one. I also don't choose a pair of headphones. They are useful, but they are a very common item. They do not have any special meaning, and they may break after one or two years.

In conclusion, a framed photograph is the best choice because it keeps our memories and shows how much I care about my friend.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the importance of teamwork skills for students. I think there are four main points.

First, a good team needs a leader. The leader guides the team and gives each member a clear task. For example, in a group project, the leader makes a plan and checks that everyone finishes on time. Without a leader, the team may waste a lot of time.

Second, sharing and combining ideas leads to better results. Each student has different strengths and different ideas. When they share and combine their ideas, they can find a better solution. As people often say, two heads are better than one.

Third, teamwork brings many benefits to studying and future careers. At university, students learn faster when they study in groups and help each other. Later, almost every job needs teamwork. In my job, I work with doctors and engineers to build AI tools for hospitals. Nobody can do this kind of work alone.

Finally, I think teamwork helps students improve their communication skills. They learn how to listen to others, explain their ideas clearly and solve problems politely. These skills are very useful in daily life.

In conclusion, teamwork skills help students follow a good leader, create better ideas, study well and communicate well. Therefore, students should practise teamwork as early as possible.
follow_ups: A good team leader should be responsible and fair. He or she should also listen to every member and give clear instructions. Most importantly, a good leader sets a good example for the team.

No, I don't think teamwork is always better. For simple tasks, working alone is often faster because we don't need to discuss anything. However, for big projects, teamwork usually gives better results.

Students can join group projects, clubs and volunteer activities. They should also practise listening to others and sharing their own ideas. Playing team sports like football is a fun way to learn teamwork too.

Hi Lan,

Thanks for your email. It is great that you are organising our end-term party. I am happy to give you some advice.

First, I think we can allow people to invite additional friends, but each person should bring only one. Our room at Hoa Sen Restaurant is quite small, and more guests will cost more money. Please ask everyone to send you their friend's name before Friday. Then you can order enough food.

Secondly, I think we should organise some games and a small competition, such as a quiz about our class. Games are fun, and everyone can join in. We can give small prizes to the winners. Dancing is a good idea too, but only at the end of the party. Some classmates are shy, so they may not want to dance.

I hope this helps. See you at the party on Saturday evening!

outline.content: Viết lại đề: giới trẻ ngày càng thích tham quan công trình cổ, bảo tàng, di tích → bài sẽ nêu nguyên nhân và ảnh hưởng

2.answer:
In recent years, more and more young people have become interested in visiting old buildings, museums and historical sites. Many sociologists and educators are interested in this change. This trend has several causes, and it has both positive and negative effects on society.

There are three main causes of this trend. Firstly, social media plays an important role. Many young people want to take beautiful photos at old places, such as Hoi An Ancient Town, and share them on Instagram or TikTok. Secondly, many museums have become more modern and interesting. For example, some museums now use VR technology and interactive screens, so visitors can learn history in a fun way. In addition, young people today are curious about their roots. They want to understand the history and culture of their country.

This trend also has several effects. On the positive side, young people learn a lot about history outside the classroom. As a result, they feel prouder of their country and want to protect its heritage. Moreover, local businesses earn more money from tourism. For instance, hotels, restaurants and souvenir shops near historical sites have more customers. On the negative side, too many visitors can damage old buildings. Some people touch old objects or write on walls, and this causes serious harm. In addition, popular places become very crowded at weekends, so visitors cannot enjoy them.

In conclusion, young people's interest in historical places comes from social media, modern museums and curiosity about their culture. This trend helps them learn and supports the local economy, but it can also damage heritage sites. Therefore, the government should make clear rules to protect these places.

If I take my best friend's six-year-old daughter out for a fun day, I will choose to go to the zoo. Let me explain why.

First, most children love animals. At Saigon Zoo, she can see elephants, tigers, monkeys and giraffes. She will be very excited to see these animals in real life, not only on TV. Second, the zoo is a great place to learn. There is a sign with information about every animal, so I can read it and teach her new things. In addition, the zoo also has big gardens and a playground. After we see the animals, she can play and have an ice cream under the trees. The tickets are also quite cheap.

I don't choose to go to an aquarium. It is interesting, but it is quite small, and most of the animals are fish. The tickets are also more expensive, and we can see everything in about one hour. I also don't choose to go to the park. There is a park near her home, and she goes there almost every day. So it is not a special day out for her.

In conclusion, the zoo is the best choice because it is fun, educational and not expensive.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of young people keeping pets. I think there are four main benefits.

First, pets provide a lot of emotional support. When young people feel sad or stressed, a pet can make them feel better. For example, my sister has a cat called Mochi. After a hard day at school, she plays with Mochi, and she feels happy again.

Second, keeping a pet can encourage a healthier daily routine. Dog owners have to walk their dogs every morning and evening. As a result, they get up earlier, exercise more and spend less time in front of their computers.

Third, pets give companionship and reduce feelings of loneliness. Many young people move to big cities like Ho Chi Minh City to study or work. They often live alone and miss their families. A pet is always there when they come home, so they feel less lonely.

Finally, I think keeping a pet helps young people learn responsibility. They have to feed the pet, wash it and take it to the vet when it is sick. These tasks teach them to care for others.

In conclusion, pets give young people emotional support, a healthier routine, companionship and a sense of responsibility. However, young people should only keep a pet if they have enough time to care for it.

Many people are too busy to take care of a pet. Some people live in small apartments, so there is not enough space. Others are worried about the cost or about allergies.

2.answer:
In recent years, more and more children have developed unhealthy eating habits. They eat a lot of fast food, sugary snacks and fizzy drinks. This growing problem worries many parents, teachers and health experts. This essay will discuss the main problems caused by this habit and suggest some possible solutions.

Unhealthy eating habits cause several serious problems for children. Firstly, they harm children's physical health. Fast food and soft drinks contain a lot of fat and sugar, so many children become overweight. Some of them may get diabetes or tooth decay at a young age. These health problems can continue when they grow up. Secondly, a poor diet can affect children's studies. Children who eat junk food often feel tired, and they find it hard to concentrate in class. Moreover, unhealthy eating can also affect their mental health. For example, some overweight children are teased by their classmates, so they feel sad and lose confidence.

There are several ways to solve this problem. Firstly, parents should cook healthy meals at home and limit snacks and soft drinks. They should also eat with their children and set a good example. Secondly, schools should serve healthy lunches with more vegetables and fruit. They can also teach students about nutrition in a fun way and stop selling soft drinks in their canteens. In addition, the government should take action. For instance, it can put a higher tax on sugary drinks and limit fast food advertisements for children.

In conclusion, unhealthy eating habits can damage children's bodies, their studies and their mental health. If families, schools and the government work together, children will eat better and grow up healthier.

2.answer:
I think the best graduation gift for my best friend is a wristwatch. Let me explain why.

First, my friend is going to start her first job soon. At work, she needs to be on time for meetings every day. A watch can help her manage her time well. Second, a nice watch makes her look professional. She can wear it to job interviews and important meetings. In addition, a good watch can last for many years. Every time she looks at it, she will remember me and her graduation day.

I don't choose a pair of headphones because she already has a good pair. Also, headphones are mostly for entertainment, such as listening to music. They are not very useful for her new job. I also don't choose a framed photograph of our friendship. It is a sweet idea, but we already have hundreds of photos together on our phones. Moreover, a photo cannot help her in her working life.

In conclusion, a wristwatch is the best choice because it is both useful and meaningful. It will be with her on the first day of her career.
