3.answer:
Today I am going to talk about why teamwork skills are important for students. I would like to mention four points.

First, a leader plays a key role in guiding a team. A good leader gives the team a clear goal. He or she also gives each member a task that suits their strengths. When there is a disagreement, the leader helps the team solve it calmly.

Second, sharing and combining ideas leads to better results. For example, in my public health class at university, my group had to plan a health campaign. One friend was good at design, and another was good at writing. When we combined our ideas, our project got the highest mark in the class.

Third, teamwork brings many benefits to studying and future careers. Students who study in groups can explain difficult lessons to each other. Later, when they look for a job, they will have an advantage, because most employers want people who can work well in a team.

Finally, teamwork helps students make friends and build good relationships. When they work together for a long time, they get to know each other well. In fact, my best friend today was a member of my first project group at university.

In conclusion, teamwork skills are very important for students. Therefore, schools and universities should give students more group projects.
follow_ups: I think a good team leader should be confident and fair. He or she should listen to every member and make quick decisions. A good leader also encourages the team when things are difficult.
Not always. Some tasks, such as writing a short report, are faster when I work alone. However, for big and difficult projects, working in a team is usually better because we can share the work.

Students can improve their teamwork skills by joining group projects and student clubs. They should practise listening to others and respecting different opinions. Taking part in volunteer activities is also very helpful.

Hi Anna,

Thanks for your email. I am happy to tell you about my camping trip.

Last weekend, I went camping at Ho Coc Beach. It is about three hours from the centre of Ho Chi Minh City by car. I went with three colleagues from my university, and we had a wonderful time.

We did a lot of fun activities during the trip. On the first day, we set up our tents near the beach and went swimming. In the evening, we had a barbecue with fresh seafood. After dinner, we sat around a campfire, sang songs and looked at the stars. The next morning, we got up early to watch the sunrise.

Yes, I would definitely recommend camping to you. It is a great way to relax and enjoy nature. You can also forget about your phone and work for a few days. However, you should bring insect spray because there are a lot of mosquitoes at night. If you like, we can go camping together at Ho Coc next month.

Let me know what you think.

Best wishes,
Minh

2.answer:
Since the pandemic, many employees around the world have started working from home. Some people believe that this helps parents build closer relationships with their children. However, others think that it mixes work and family life and harms these relationships. In my opinion, working from home can make family bonds stronger, but only if parents set clear limits.

On the one hand, working from home can help parents spend more time with their children. Firstly, they can have lunch with their children and take them to school every day. These small moments help families feel closer. Secondly, parents do not have to travel to work, so they save time and feel less tired. As a result, they have more energy to play with their children in the evening. In addition, parents can notice their children's problems more quickly. For example, a mother at home can see if her son is sad after school and talk to him.

On the other hand, other people argue that working from home blurs the line between work and family life. Firstly, children often interrupt their parents during online meetings. This makes parents stressed, and they may shout at their children. Secondly, many people work late at night because their office is always next to them. Moreover, some parents are at home, but they are always busy with their laptops. Their children may feel ignored and lonely, even though their parents are in the next room.

In conclusion, working from home can give parents more time with their children, but it can also cause stress and confusion at home. I believe that it has a positive effect if parents have clear working hours and a separate place to work.

2.answer:
I think the Science Club should hold a science quiz and game competition. Let me explain why.

First, a competition is fun and exciting, so it can attract a lot of students. Many students think science is difficult and boring, but everyone loves games. Second, students can learn science in an easy way. They can play in teams and answer questions about the human body, space or technology. In this way, they learn new things without feeling stressed. In addition, the club can give small prizes to the winners. After the event, many students will want to join the club because they had a good time and made new friends.

I don't choose to invite a well-known scientist to give a guest talk. Famous scientists are very busy, so it is difficult and expensive to invite them. Also, some students may feel bored if they only sit and listen for two hours. I also don't choose to organize a science book donation drive. It is a kind activity, but it does not make students more interested in science. It cannot attract many new members either.

In conclusion, a science quiz and game competition is the best choice because it is fun, cheap and attractive to students.

3.answer:
Today I would like to explain why face-to-face communication is more beneficial than other types of communication. I have four main reasons.

First, when we talk face to face, we can convey our emotions and body language clearly. The other person can see our smile, our eyes and our gestures, and they can hear our tone of voice. For example, when a doctor talks to a worried patient in person, the patient can see that the doctor really cares.

Second, face-to-face communication reduces misunderstandings compared to text-based communication. A short text message can easily be misunderstood. When we meet, we can ask questions and explain our ideas immediately.

Third, meeting in person builds stronger and more trusting relationships. When I have coffee with my friends, we talk and laugh together for hours. As a result, we understand each other better and trust each other more.

Finally, I think face-to-face communication helps us solve problems faster. At work, my team sometimes sends emails all day about one small problem. But when we sit together for thirty minutes, we can usually find a solution.

In conclusion, face-to-face communication helps us show emotions, avoid misunderstandings, build trust and solve problems quickly. However, online communication is still useful when we are far away from each other.
follow_ups: Yes, I think so. Many young people prefer chatting on their phones to talking in person. As a result, some of them feel nervous when they have to speak face to face.

Online communication is more suitable when people live far away from each other. It is also useful for quick messages or for online meetings with partners in other countries. During the pandemic, it was the safest way to communicate.
First, people should put their phones away and listen carefully to others. They should also make eye contact and smile when they speak. Joining clubs or giving presentations is good practice too.

2.answer:
In today's competitive job market, more and more employees change jobs frequently instead of staying with one company for many years. This essay will discuss the main causes of this trend and its effects on both workers and companies.

There are several reasons why people change jobs so often. Firstly, many workers want a higher salary. A new company often offers more money to attract experienced staff, so moving is the fastest way to earn more. Secondly, young people want to learn new skills and find better chances for promotion. If they stay in one job for too long, they may feel bored and stop developing. In addition, some people leave because of a bad working environment. For example, they may have a difficult boss or too much overtime work.

Changing jobs frequently has both positive and negative effects. For individuals, it can bring a better income and a wide range of experience. However, it can also lead to a lack of stability. Workers have to start again in each new company, and some employers do not trust a CV with too many short jobs. For organisations, the effects are mostly negative. Firstly, companies have to spend a lot of time and money on hiring and training new staff. Moreover, when an experienced employee leaves, the rest of the team has more work and more pressure.

In conclusion, people change jobs often because they want better pay, new skills and a better working environment. This trend can help workers in the short term, but it causes problems for both workers and companies. Therefore, companies should offer fair salaries and a good working environment to keep their staff.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of learning a new language. In my opinion, there are four main benefits.

First, learning a language has cognitive benefits, such as improved memory and problem-solving skills. When we learn a language, we have to remember a lot of new words and grammar rules. This is good exercise for our brain. We also learn to guess the meaning of new words, so we become better at solving problems.

Second, a new language brings more career and educational opportunities. Many international companies pay higher salaries to staff who can speak English. Students who know a foreign language can also apply for scholarships to study abroad. In my job, I read many medical research papers in English every week.

Third, learning a language helps us understand other cultures and build stronger connections with others. When we know a language, we also learn about the customs and the way of thinking of its people. For example, I am learning Japanese, and now I can chat with my Japanese colleague in her language. She is very happy about that.

Finally, we can enjoy films, books and music in the original language. I love watching English films without subtitles. It is more interesting than reading the translation.

In conclusion, learning a new language makes our brain stronger, gives us more opportunities, connects us with others and makes entertainment more fun. I think everyone should try to learn at least one new language.
follow_ups: I think the best way is to practise a little every day. Learners should listen to podcasts, watch films and speak with native speakers as much as possible. They should not be afraid of making mistakes.

Yes, I think everyone should learn at least one foreign language. The world is more connected today, so we often need to talk to people from other countries. A foreign language also gives us more job opportunities.

Technology helps people a lot. There are many free apps like Duolingo, and learners can practise for ten minutes a day on their phones. They can also join online classes with teachers from other countries.

2.answer:
Nowadays, advertising is everywhere in our lives. We can see advertisements on television, on social media, on websites and even on the streets. Advertising gives people useful information, but it also has some bad effects on consumers and society. This essay will discuss both the advantages and disadvantages of advertising.

On the one hand, advertising brings several benefits. Firstly, it gives consumers useful information about new products, prices and special offers. For example, when a supermarket advertises a sale, customers can save money. Secondly, advertising helps businesses grow. When a company advertises well, it sells more products and can create more jobs. This supports the growth of the economy. In addition, advertising pays for a lot of free services. We can watch videos on YouTube or read online newspapers for free because companies pay for the ads.

On the other hand, advertising also has some negative effects. Firstly, it often persuades people to buy things that they do not really need. As a result, some people spend too much money and get into debt. Secondly, some advertisements give false information. For instance, many ads on Facebook say that a health product can cure serious diseases, and some people believe them. Moreover, advertising can have a bad influence on children. Many ads for fast food and soft drinks target young children, and this can lead to unhealthy eating habits.

In conclusion, advertising has both advantages and disadvantages. It provides information, supports businesses and pays for free media, but it can also lead to overspending, false information and bad habits in children. Therefore, consumers should think carefully before they buy, and the government should control advertising more strictly.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the importance of leadership. In my opinion, a good leader is important for four main reasons.

First, a good leader guides and motivates team members towards common goals. The leader explains the goal clearly, so everyone knows what to do. He or she also praises team members when they do a good job. For example, my supervisor at the university always encourages us, so we work harder.

Second, leaders need to make effective decisions in difficult situations. When there is a problem, the team often feels worried. A good leader stays calm, listens to everyone and then makes a quick decision. During the COVID-19 pandemic, hospital leaders had to make many hard decisions every day to protect patients.

Third, a leader builds trust and maintains team cohesion. If the leader is honest and fair, team members will trust him or her. As a result, they work well together and help each other.

Finally, I think a good leader helps team members develop their skills. The leader gives them new tasks, gives useful feedback and shares his or her experience. Because of this, team members grow and become better at their jobs.

In conclusion, leadership is very important for any team. A good leader sets goals, makes good decisions, builds trust and helps people grow.
follow_ups: I think leadership skills can be learned. Some people are born confident, but everyone can learn to plan, listen and make decisions. For example, students can practise leadership in clubs and group projects.
A good leader should be responsible, honest and fair. He or she should also be a good listener. Most importantly, a good leader always sets a good example for the team.
I admire my supervisor, Professor Lan. She leads our AI research team at the university, and she is very kind and smart. She always listens to our ideas and helps us when we have problems.

2.answer:
Nowadays, more and more people spend their time and money on travelling. They visit new places and learn about new cultures, both in their own country and abroad. Travelling brings many benefits, but it also has some drawbacks. This essay will discuss the main advantages and disadvantages of tourism and travel.

On the one hand, travelling brings many benefits. Firstly, it helps people learn about new cultures. When we visit another country, we can try local food, see traditional festivals and talk to local people. As a result, we become more open-minded. Secondly, travelling helps people relax. After months of hard work, a short trip to the beach or the mountains can reduce stress. In addition, tourism is good for the economy. For example, Hoi An earns a lot of money from tourists, and many local people work in hotels, restaurants and shops.

On the other hand, tourism and travel also have some drawbacks. Firstly, tourism can damage the environment. Many tourists leave rubbish on beaches, and the water in places like Ha Long Bay becomes polluted. Secondly, popular places can become too crowded. Prices for food and housing also go up, so life becomes harder for local people. Moreover, local culture may change in a bad way. Some traditional festivals become shows for tourists, and they lose their real meaning.

In conclusion, travelling helps people learn, relax and support the economy, but it can also cause pollution, overcrowding and the loss of local culture. I believe that we should still travel, but we need to travel responsibly. For example, we should keep places clean and respect local people.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the responsibilities of keeping pets. In my opinion, pet owners have four main responsibilities.

First, owners must provide proper food, shelter and healthcare. Pets need healthy food and clean water every day. They also need a safe and clean place to sleep. In addition, owners should take their pets to the vet for vaccinations and check-ups.

Second, owners should ensure regular exercise and attention. For example, dogs need a walk every day to stay healthy. Cats also need their owners to play with them. Pets can feel sad and lonely if they stay alone all day.

Third, keeping a pet means being financially and emotionally committed long-term. A dog or a cat can live for ten to fifteen years. During this time, owners have to pay for food, medicine and other things. They must also love their pets even when they are old or sick. Sadly, some people leave their pets on the street when they get bored.

Finally, I think owners have to train their pets to behave well. Dogs should not bark all night or bite strangers. If pets behave well, the neighbours will not be disturbed, and everyone will be safe.

In conclusion, pet owners must give their pets good care, exercise, love and training for many years. So before we get a pet, we should think carefully.
follow_ups: In Vietnam, dogs and cats are the most popular pets. Dogs are loyal and can protect the house, and cats can catch mice. Some people also keep fish or birds because they are easy to look after.
Pets can make us happy and reduce stress. They also give us company, so we feel less lonely. In addition, walking a dog every day helps the owner stay fit.
Pets can be expensive because owners have to pay for food and medical care. They can also be noisy and damage furniture. Some people are allergic to pet hair, and some pets can carry diseases.

2.answer:
In recent years, the number of tourists has risen sharply in many popular places around the world. For example, Ha Long Bay and Hoi An in Vietnam welcome millions of visitors every year. This growth brings both advantages and disadvantages, and this essay will discuss both sides.

On the one hand, more tourists bring several benefits. Firstly, tourism creates many jobs for local people. Hotels, restaurants and shops need more staff, so people can earn a better income. Secondly, the government can collect more money from tourism. This money can be used to build better roads, hospitals and schools for the local community. In addition, tourism helps to protect local culture. Many tourists want to see traditional festivals and buy handmade products, so local people keep their traditions alive.

On the other hand, the rise in tourist numbers also causes serious problems. Firstly, it harms the environment. Tourists leave a lot of rubbish on beaches and in the mountains, and more flights and cars cause air pollution. Secondly, the quality of life for residents can become worse. Streets become crowded and noisy, and traffic jams happen more often. Moreover, the prices of houses and food usually go up in tourist areas. As a result, many local people cannot afford to live in their own hometown.

In conclusion, more tourists can bring jobs, money and cultural benefits to popular destinations. However, they can also damage the environment and make life harder for local people. In my opinion, governments should control the number of visitors and ask tourists to pay a small fee to protect these places.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the negative effects of social media on young people. In my opinion, there are four main effects.

First, social media can increase the risk of anxiety and depression. Many teenagers worry about the number of likes and comments on their posts. If they do not get enough likes, they feel sad and lonely. Some of them also face online bullying.

Second, social media reduces face-to-face social interaction. Young people spend hours chatting online, but they rarely meet their friends in person. For example, I often see a group of friends in a coffee shop who look at their phones and do not talk to each other.

Third, young people are exposed to misinformation and unrealistic comparisons. There is a lot of fake news online, especially about health. In addition, people usually post only perfect photos of their lives. When teenagers compare themselves with these photos, they feel unhappy about their bodies and their lives.

Finally, I think social media causes poor sleep and less time for study. Many students use their phones late at night, so they feel tired in class the next day. As a result, their grades may go down.

In conclusion, social media can hurt the mental health, relationships and studies of young people. Therefore, they should use it carefully and limit their screen time.
follow_ups: I think young people are more vulnerable because they do not have much life experience. They easily believe what they see online. They also care a lot about what their friends think of them.

Parents should set clear rules, such as no phones during meals or after 10 p.m. They should also talk to their children about fake news and online safety. Most importantly, parents should be good examples.
Yes, I think they should. They should remove harmful content and fake news quickly. They should also check users' ages and limit the time that children can spend on their apps.

2.answer:
Nowadays, many people of all ages share details of their daily lives on social media. Some people think this habit helps them connect with others and keep their memories, while others believe it harms their privacy and creates pressure. In my opinion, sharing online is useful, but people should do it carefully.

On the one hand, there are good reasons why people share their lives online. Firstly, it helps them stay connected with friends and family. For example, my cousin lives in Canada, but I can see photos of her children on Facebook every week. Secondly, sharing posts helps people preserve their memories. Social media works like an online diary, and many apps remind users of what they did years ago. In addition, people can find others with the same interests. When someone posts about a hobby, such as cooking or travelling, they can make new friends.

On the other hand, many people argue that sharing their lives online causes serious problems. Firstly, it can invade people's privacy. When someone posts their address, their school or their daily plans, strangers can find them easily. As a result, they may become victims of crime. Secondly, social media creates pressure to show a perfect life. Many users only post beautiful photos, and they often edit these photos carefully. Other people compare themselves with these images and feel unhappy about their own lives.

In conclusion, sharing daily life on social media can help people connect and keep memories, but it can also cause privacy problems and stress. I believe people can continue to share, but they should think carefully before they post. They should also never share private information, such as their home address or bank details.

2.answer:
If I saw my friend cheating during an exam, I would talk directly to my friend about it. Let me explain why.

First, talking to my friend is honest and kind at the same time. After the exam, I would meet him in private and tell him what I saw. I would explain that cheating is wrong and unfair to other students. Second, this way gives my friend a chance to change. He may feel ashamed and promise not to do it again. I could also offer to study with him for the next exam, so he would not need to cheat.

I don't choose to ignore what I saw and say nothing. If I say nothing, my friend will think that cheating is acceptable, and he may do it again. It is also unfair to the students who study hard. I also don't choose to report the incident to the teacher straight away. My friend might fail the exam or get a serious punishment from the school, and our friendship might end. However, if he continues to cheat, I will report it.

In conclusion, talking directly to my friend is the best choice because it solves the problem and keeps our friendship.

outline.reusable: In conclusion, cashless payment is convenient, safe, fast and helpful for managing money.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of cashless payment. In Vietnam, more and more people pay by phone or by card. I think there are four main benefits.

First, cashless payment brings convenience in daily transactions. I only need my phone to buy coffee, pay for a taxi or pay my electricity bill. I do not need to carry a heavy wallet or look for small change.

Second, it gives better safety and security for our money. If I lose my wallet, I lose all my cash. But if I lose my phone, nobody can use my bank app without my password or my face.

Third, cashless payment is fast and efficient. At the supermarket, I just scan a QR code, and the payment is done in a few seconds. As a result, shops can serve more customers, and the queues are shorter.

Finally, I think cashless payment makes it easy to track our spending. Every payment is saved in the bank app. At the end of the month, I can check how much money I spent on food and shopping. This helps me save money.

In conclusion, cashless payment is convenient, safe, fast and helpful for managing money. That is why I almost never use cash now.
follow_ups: I don't think it will replace cash completely, at least not soon. Many old people and people in the countryside still prefer cash. However, I believe cash will become less common.
The biggest risk is online fraud. Some criminals send fake messages to steal bank passwords. In addition, if the internet or the bank system stops working, people cannot pay.
It has changed shopping habits a lot in Vietnam. Now people even pay by QR code at street food stalls and local markets. People also shop online more often because payment is so easy.

2.answer:
Nowadays, many people ask what really makes them happy at work. Some people believe that salary is the most important factor in job satisfaction, while others think that the working environment and chances for growth matter more. In my opinion, salary is important, but the other factors matter more in the long term.

On the one hand, there are good reasons why salary is important. Firstly, people need money to pay for their basic needs, such as food, housing and health care. If the salary is too low, workers feel worried all the time and cannot focus on their jobs. Secondly, a high salary shows that the company values its employees. For example, when workers get a pay rise, they usually feel proud and work harder. In addition, a good income helps people support their families and save for the future.

On the other hand, many people argue that other factors are more important than money. Firstly, a friendly working environment makes people enjoy going to work every day. When colleagues help each other and the manager is kind, employees feel less stressed. Secondly, opportunities for growth keep workers motivated. For instance, many young people choose a job with training courses and a clear path to promotion, even if the pay is lower. Moreover, a high salary cannot make people happy if they hate their job.

In conclusion, salary helps people meet their basic needs, but a good working environment and chances to grow bring long-term happiness. I believe a fair salary is necessary, but it is not enough. Companies should also create a positive workplace and help their staff develop their skills.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the impact of technology on study habits. I think technology has changed the way we study in four main ways.

First, students develop digital skills through online learning tools. When they use platforms like Google Classroom or Zoom, they learn how to send files, join video calls and work online with classmates. These skills are very useful for their future jobs.

Second, students use software and applications to organize and manage their study. For example, I use Google Calendar to plan my study time and Notion to keep my notes. Some apps also remind students about deadlines, so they do not forget their homework.

Third, technology enables flexible study schedules and remote learning. Students can watch recorded lessons at any time and in any place. For example, during the COVID-19 pandemic, my younger sister studied online at home for many months. Many working adults also take online courses in the evening.

Finally, I think technology gives students easy access to information. In the past, students had to go to the library to find books. Now they can search for information on the internet in a few seconds.

In conclusion, technology helps students learn new skills, manage their time, study flexibly and find information quickly. However, they should not spend too much time on games and social media.
follow_ups: I think technology has made studying much easier. Students can find information and learn online at any time. However, it can also distract them because phones have many games and social media apps.
I often use Google Scholar to find research papers and Quizlet to learn new words. I also use ChatGPT to explain difficult ideas, but I always check its answers carefully.

Yes, but only to some extent. Technology can make lessons more interesting with videos and online quizzes. However, teachers are still very important, and students also need to read books and write by hand.

outline.content: Viết lại đề: nhiều học sinh học thêm, số khác không; hai quan điểm → ý kiến: có ích nhưng không nên học quá nhiều

2.answer:
Today, many students go to extra classes after school, while others do not join any extra classes at all. Some people think these classes help students improve their knowledge and skills, but others believe they create pressure and take away free time. In my opinion, extra classes can be useful, but students should not take too many.

On the one hand, extra classes bring several benefits. Firstly, they help students understand difficult subjects better. For example, a student who is weak at maths can get extra help from a teacher in a small class. Secondly, students can learn new skills that schools do not teach, such as music, art or swimming. These skills make them more confident and creative. In addition, extra classes can help students prepare for important exams. As a result, they have a better chance of entering a good university.

On the other hand, many people argue that extra classes are harmful to young learners. Firstly, they put a lot of pressure on students. Many children study at school all day and then go to extra classes until late at night, so they feel tired and stressed. Secondly, students lose their free time. They do not have enough time to play sports, relax or spend time with their families. Moreover, extra classes are often expensive, so they can be a heavy burden for many families.

In conclusion, extra classes can improve students' knowledge and skills, but too many classes can cause stress and take away their free time. I believe students should only join one or two classes that they really need or enjoy. Parents should also make sure that their children have enough time to rest and play.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the reasons why young people nowadays prefer eating out. I think there are four main reasons.

First, young people have busy lifestyles and lack time to cook. Many of them study or work all day and come home late. Cooking and washing dishes take a lot of time, so they prefer to eat at a restaurant near their office or school.

Second, eating out is a good way to socialize with friends. Young people often meet at a restaurant to celebrate birthdays or just to chat after work. For example, my friends and I have dinner together every Friday evening at a hotpot restaurant.

Third, there is a wide variety of food choices available. In big cities like Ho Chi Minh City, you can find Vietnamese, Korean, Japanese and Italian food on the same street. Young people love trying new dishes, so eating out is exciting for them.

Finally, I think the affordable prices of food are another reason. In Vietnam, a bowl of noodles or a plate of broken rice costs only about thirty or forty thousand dong. Sometimes it is even cheaper than cooking at home, especially for people who live alone.

In conclusion, young people eat out because they are busy, they want to meet friends, they enjoy many kinds of food and the prices are reasonable. However, they should also cook at home sometimes to stay healthy.

2.answer:
In the digital age, fewer and fewer people read books in their free time. Instead, they spend hours on smartphones and social media, and this is especially true for young people. This essay will discuss the problems caused by this decline and suggest some solutions.

The decline in reading habits has several negative effects. Firstly, people's language skills become weaker. When young people do not read books, they learn fewer new words and make more mistakes in their writing. Secondly, people may lose the ability to focus for a long time. Many videos on TikTok last only a few seconds, so teenagers find it hard to finish a long text. In addition, people may lose their critical thinking skills. Those who only read short posts online often believe fake news without checking it.

However, there are several solutions to this problem. Firstly, parents should be good examples for their children. If parents read books at home every evening, their children will copy this habit. Secondly, schools should make reading more fun. For example, they can organise reading clubs, book fairs and reading competitions with small prizes. Moreover, the government should build more modern libraries and support e-books. Young people love technology, so reading on tablets or listening to audiobooks can be a good start.

In conclusion, the decline in reading can weaken people's language skills, their focus and their critical thinking. However, families, schools and the government can work together to solve this problem. I believe that if we make books fun and easy to access, more people will return to reading.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about the benefits of keeping pets. I think pets bring four main benefits to their owners.

First, pets help improve physical health through daily activities. For example, dog owners need to walk their dogs every morning and evening. As a result, they exercise more and become healthier. My neighbour, Mr Hai, walks his dog for thirty minutes every day, and he is very fit for his age.

Second, pets provide emotional support and reduce stress. After a long day at work, playing with a cat or a dog makes people feel calm and happy. Pets are also good friends for old people and people who live alone, so they feel less lonely.

Third, pets help strengthen bonds within the family. Family members often take care of the pet together, such as feeding it or taking it to the vet. They also play with it and talk about it, so they spend more time together.

Finally, I think keeping pets teaches children responsibility. When children feed their pet and clean its home every day, they learn to care for others. They also learn to keep promises and follow a daily routine.

In conclusion, pets are good for our bodies, our minds, our families and our children. However, before buying a pet, people should make sure they have enough time and money to look after it.

1.answer:
Hi Linh,

Thanks for your email. I am so excited that you want to visit my new house!

My new house is in District 7, Ho Chi Minh City. The house is in a small street near Nguyen Thi Thap Street. It is a quiet area with many trees, and it is only five minutes from Lotte Mart.

Getting there is quite easy. From the city centre, you can take a bus or book a Grab car. The trip takes about thirty minutes. When you see a big pharmacy on Nguyen Thi Thap Street, turn left into the small street there. My house is the third one on the right, and it has a blue gate.

I am planning to decorate my house in a simple and modern style. I will paint the walls white and put a lot of green plants in the living room. I also want to make a small reading corner with a bookshelf because I love reading.

Why don't you come on Sunday at 10 a.m.? I will cook lunch for you. Let me know if that time works for you.

Best wishes,
Minh

outline.reusable: I believe that online shopping will continue to grow in the future.

2.answer:
In recent years, online shopping has become very popular all over the world. Instead of going to traditional shops, many people now buy goods through websites and mobile apps such as Shopee or Lazada. This essay will discuss the main reasons for this change.

The first group of reasons is about convenience. Firstly, online shopping saves a lot of time. People can buy things at any time of the day without leaving their homes, so it is very useful for busy workers. Secondly, delivery services have become fast and cheap. For example, in big cities in Vietnam, customers can receive their orders in only one or two days. In addition, cashless payment makes online shopping easy and safe. People can pay by e-wallet or bank card with just a few clicks.

Another group of reasons is about price and choice. Firstly, products online are often cheaper than in shops. Online sellers do not need to rent a shop, so they can offer lower prices and many discounts. Secondly, customers can choose from a huge variety of products. They can compare prices and read reviews from other buyers before they decide. Moreover, smartphones and the internet have helped online shopping develop. Today, almost everyone has a phone, so people can shop anywhere, even on the bus.

In conclusion, online shopping has become popular because it is convenient, fast and cheap, and it offers many choices. Technology has also made it easier than ever before. I believe that online shopping will continue to grow in the future, but traditional shops will still be important for some people.

2.answer:
I think the campaign should focus on using a phone while driving first. Let me explain why.

First, this behaviour is very dangerous. When drivers look at their phones, they do not see the road for a few seconds. In that short time, they can hit another vehicle or a person. Second, it can kill not only the driver but also innocent people. For example, many traffic accidents in Vietnam happen because motorbike riders read messages while riding. In addition, this problem is very common, especially among young people. So a campaign can save many lives quickly.

I don't choose smoking in public places as the first target. Smoking is harmful to health, but it causes damage slowly over many years. Also, Vietnam already has a law that bans smoking in many public places, such as hospitals and schools. I also don't choose making noise in public areas. Noise is annoying, and it can make people stressed, but it rarely kills anyone.

In conclusion, using a phone while driving is the most harmful behaviour because it can cause deadly accidents in seconds. That is why the campaign should target it first.

3.answer:
Today I would like to talk about how communication has changed compared to the past. I think there are four main changes.

First, modern tools are fast and convenient. In the past, people wrote letters, and a letter took many days or even weeks to arrive. Now we can send a message or an email in one second. We can also make video calls from anywhere.

Second, digital communication has replaced a lot of face-to-face communication. In the past, people usually met in person to talk and share news. Today, many people prefer to chat online. Digital communication is easy, but sometimes we cannot see the feelings of the other person, so misunderstandings happen.

Third, smartphones and social media play a very important role. Almost everyone has a smartphone, and we use apps like Zalo and Facebook every day. We can share photos, news and our feelings with hundreds of people at the same time.

Finally, I think communication with people abroad is much cheaper now. In the past, international phone calls were very expensive, so people only called abroad on special days. Now I can call my cousin in Australia for free over the internet.

In conclusion, communication today is faster, cheaper and easier than in the past. However, I believe we should still meet our family and friends face to face.
follow_ups: I think they have made people both closer and more distant. We can easily contact people who live far away. However, many families sit together but look at their own phones instead of talking.
I use Zalo most often because my family, friends and colleagues all use it. It is free and easy to use. For work, I also use email because it is more formal.

I think AI will play a bigger role in communication. For example, AI tools will translate languages instantly, so people from different countries can talk easily. We may also use virtual reality to meet each other online.
